Measurements of the phase of the transmission coefficient for a weak probe signal reveal a large increase and pronounced oscillations in the phase length variation as a function of the microwave power of the pump. Experimental observations are explained on the basis of the developed theoretical approach suitable for the description of the nonlinear response of strongly driven JTLs. Using the derived nonlinear wave equation, we show that the behavior of the phase length variation is associated with the oscillatory dependence of the Josephson inductances on the microwave power. It is demonstrated that the dissipation-induced propagation losses increase in the strongly nonlinear regime and also lead to smearing out the phase length oscillations. The developed theoretical analysis is in good agreement with experimental observations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。判断依据关键词：experimental and theoretical studies、measurements、theoretical approach、derived nonlinear wave equation。；研究对象：约瑟夫森传输线（JTLs）在强驱动下的强非线性响应行为，特别是通过双音谱学探测的离共振强非线性区域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过增加泵浦微波功率，JTL从弱非线性过渡到强非线性区域，弱探针信号的传输系数相位长度随泵浦功率出现大幅增加和显著振荡，该振荡源于约瑟夫森电感对微波功率的振荡依赖关系；强非线性区域中耗散引起的传播损耗增加并导致相位长度振荡被抹平。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过增加泵浦微波功率，JTL从弱非线性过渡到强非线性区域，弱探针信号的传输系数相位长度随泵浦功率出现大幅增加和显著振荡，该振荡源于约瑟夫森电感对微波功率的振荡依赖关系；强非线性区域中耗散引起的传播损耗增加并导致相位长度振荡被抹平。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用双音谱学（two-tone spectroscopy）测量弱探针信号的传输系数相位；理论上推导了适用于强驱动JTL的非线性波动方程，并基于约瑟夫森电感随微波功率的振荡行为解释相位长度变化。

papers.title: Strong Optical-Optical Avoided Crossings Suppress Thermal Conductivity in Ga-Substituted TlInTe$_2$
papers.abstract: In crystalline solids, avoided crossing between acoustic and optical phonons is widely recognized as an effective mechanism for suppressing lattice thermal conductivity ($κ_l$). However, the role of avoided crossings among optical phonons remains largely unexplored due to their weak contribution to heat transport. Here, using first-principles calculations combined with the linearized Wigner transport equation (LWTE), we demonstrate that optical-optical avoided crossings can effectively reduce ($κ_l$) in TlIn$_{0.5}$Ga$_{0.5}$Te$_2$. Pristine TlInTe$_2$ exhibits strong optical phonon-dominated heat transport, where optical phonons contribute nearly 63% of $κ_l$. The phonon dispersion of TlInTe$_2$ shows several crossing points in the optical region, which evolve into avoided crossings after 50% Ga substitution. Irreducible representation analysis reveals that the crossing phonon branches in TlInTe$_2$ belong to different symmetry representations, whereas the corresponding branches in TlIn$_{0.5}$Ga$_{0.5}$Te$_2$ possess the same symmetry representation, which enables phonon modes to couple and results in gap opening at the crossing points. These avoided crossings significantly suppress the optical phonon group velocity, thereby reducing the optical phonon contribution from 63% to 44% and lowering $κ_l$ from 0.568 to 0.482 Wm$^{-1}$K$^{-1}$ at 300 K. Mode-averaged transport analysis further confirms that the suppression of $κ_l$ is primarily governed by reduced phonon group velocity ($v_g$), while enhanced anharmonic scattering provides an additional secondary contribution. Our results establish symmetry-modified optical-optical avoided crossing as an effective route to suppress optical phonon transport and reduce $κ_l$ in systems where optical phonons significantly contribute to heat transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations、linearized Wigner transport equation (LWTE)。；研究对象：Ga取代的TlInTe₂（具体为TlIn₀.₅Ga₀.₅Te₂）及其晶格热导率（κ_l）的抑制机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光学-光学声子间的强避免交叉可有效抑制晶格热导率，在TlIn₀.₅Ga₀.₅Te₂中，该机制使光学声子对热导率的贡献从63%降至44%，总κ_l从0.568降至0.482 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹（300 K）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光学-光学声子间的强避免交叉可有效抑制晶格热导率，在TlIn₀.₅Ga₀.₅Te₂中，该机制使光学声子对热导率的贡献从63%降至44%，总κ_l从0.568降至0.482 Wm⁻¹K⁻¹（300 K）。；创新点：首次揭示了光学-光学声子间的避免交叉（而非传统关注的声学-光学声子避免交叉）在光学声子主导热输运的体系中抑制晶格热导率的关键作用，并指出对称性匹配是导致能隙打开和群速度降低的物理根源。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算结合线性化Wigner输运方程（LWTE），并辅以不可约表示分析及模式平均输运分析。

papers.title: Beyond Critical Minerals Targets: Digital Rock Physics as Infrastructure for Secure and Circular Supply Chains
papers.abstract: The United Kingdom and Europe are moving rapidly from critical minerals target-setting to implementation. The EU Critical Raw Materials Act and the UK's Vision 2035 create ambitious benchmarks for domestic extraction, processing, recycling, circularity, and supply-chain resilience, but many prospective regional resources remain complex, under-explored, historically worked, or economically marginal. This paper argues that implementation will depend not only on permitting reform and project designation, but also on pre-competitive measurement, modelling, and data infrastructure capable of determining which ores, brines, waste streams, and recycling feedstocks can be processed viably and with lower environmental impact. Digital Rock Physics (DRP) should therefore be understood as enabling infrastructure for resource policy rather than as a specialist laboratory method alone. By combining three-dimensional imaging, correlative chemistry, AI-enabled image analysis, and pore-scale modelling, DRP can connect mineral texture and reactive pathways to decisions about ore characterisation, liberation prediction, leaching, Direct Lithium Extraction, mine-waste valorisation, and battery recycling. The paper sets out a UK-European policy agenda built around translational demonstrators, cross-disciplinary training, a Digital Ore Passport standard, a federated Digital Ore Database, and integrated geo-reactive end stations. Treated as shared implementation infrastructure, DRP could help turn critical minerals strategies into practical routes for supply security, resource efficiency, circularity, and more environmentally responsible development.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：政策分析与技术综述型文章。关键词：argues、policy agenda、enabling infrastructure，非传统实验/计算/理论文章。；研究对象：数字岩石物理学（Digital Rock Physics, DRP）作为关键矿物供应链的基础设施，应用于矿石、卤水、废物流及回收原料的加工可行性评估。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DRP应被视为资源政策的使能基础设施，而非仅实验室方法；通过三维成像、关联化学、AI图像分析和孔隙尺度建模，DRP能将矿物结构与反应路径联系起来，支撑矿石表征、解离预测、浸出、直接提锂、矿山废料增值及电池回收等决策。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DRP应被视为资源政策的使能基础设施，而非仅实验室方法；通过三维成像、关联化学、AI图像分析和孔隙尺度建模，DRP能将矿物结构与反应路径联系起来，支撑矿石表征、解离预测、浸出、直接提锂、矿山废料增值及电池回收等决策。；创新点：提出将DRP作为共享实施基础设施，并围绕转化示范、跨学科培训、数字矿石护照标准、联邦数字矿石数据库及集成地球反应终端站，构建英国-欧洲政策议程。摘要未突出说明与传统DRP研究的具体技术差异。
papers.method_zh: 三维成像、关联化学分析、AI驱动的图像分析、孔隙尺度建模。具体涉及：矿石表征、解离预测、浸出工艺、直接提锂（Direct Lithium Extraction）、矿山废料增值、电池回收等环节的DRP应用。

papers.title: Majorana-like fermion physics: Emergence of topologically protected vortical states in graphene interacting with an electromagnetic field
papers.abstract: Within the framework of a quasi-relativistic model of graphene that admits topologically nontrivial Majorana-like quasiparticle excitations, appearance of such vortex states in the frequency dependencies of the complex dielectric permittivity of the system subjected to an external electromagnetic field has been examined. The vortex graphene states possess topological charges (flavours ) being nonzero Zak phases. Interaction effects of Majorana-like modes have been qualitatively related to the formation of Fano resonances in the optical response. The constructed topological model of graphene may be considered as a toy model of three-flavour mass-neutrino oscillations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“准相对论模型”“拓扑模型”“定性关联”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算数据。；研究对象：石墨烯在外加电磁场作用下的准粒子激发行为，具体为类似马约拉纳费米子的涡旋态及其在复介电常数频率依赖关系中的表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在石墨烯的准相对论模型中，存在拓扑非平凡的类马约拉纳准粒子激发，这些涡旋态具有非零的Zak相位（拓扑电荷/味），其相互作用效应可定性关联到光学响应中的Fano共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在石墨烯的准相对论模型中，存在拓扑非平凡的类马约拉纳准粒子激发，这些涡旋态具有非零的Zak相位（拓扑电荷/味），其相互作用效应可定性关联到光学响应中的Fano共振。；创新点：将石墨烯中的类马约拉纳准粒子激发与拓扑保护的涡旋态联系起来，并指出该模型可作为三味中微子质量振荡的玩具模型。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于准相对论模型框架，分析系统复介电常数的频率依赖关系，通过拓扑电荷（Zak相位）表征涡旋态，并定性讨论类马约拉纳模式的相互作用与Fano共振的关联。

papers.title: BCS-BEC crossover driven by small Fermi pockets of a high-Tc cuprate superconductor
papers.abstract: Fermi arcs observed in underdoped cuprates have sparked debate over whether they represent segments of a large Fermi surface or small Fermi pockets. This ambiguity has long hindered their classification as either the conventional Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) regime or the strongly coupled Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) crossover limit. Here, using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and quantum oscillations, we demonstrate the coexistence of a small Fermi pocket and a large superconducting gap in the clean inner CuO2 layers of the four-layer cuprate Ba2Ca3Cu4O8(F,O)2. This coexistence constitutes a hallmark of the BCS-BEC crossover and has remained elusive for decades. Despite the presence of antiferromagnetic (AF) order, the superconducting gap in the small pocket is remarkably large, yielding a gap-to-Fermi-energy ratio (Delta_pocket/e_F ~ 0.6) and a critical-to-Fermi-temperature ratio (Tc/TF ~ 1.3) that reach the theoretical upper bound for two-dimensional superconductivity. Unexpectedly, this BCS-BEC crossover emerges not as the carrier density decreases but as it increases, abruptly within a narrow doping range of less than 1%. These results provide a long-sought microscopic foundation for the d-wave pairing mechanism in doped AF-Mott insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和量子振荡（quantum oscillations）实验手段。；研究对象：欠掺杂铜氧化物高温超导体中的费米弧与费米口袋问题，具体材料为四层铜氧化物Ba₂Ca₃Cu₄O₈(F,O)₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在清洁的内层CuO₂中同时存在小费米口袋和大超导能隙，其能隙与费米能之比（Δ_pocket/ε_F ~ 0.6）及临界温度与费米温度之比（T_c/T_F ~ 1.3）达到二维超导的理论上限，标志着BCS-BEC交叉的实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在清洁的内层CuO₂中同时存在小费米口袋和大超导能隙，其能隙与费米能之比（Δ_pocket/ε_F ~ 0.6）及临界温度与费米温度之比（T_c/T_F ~ 1.3）达到二维超导的理论上限，标志着BCS-BEC交叉的实现。；创新点：首次在铜氧化物超导体中实验观察到小费米口袋与大超导能隙共存，这是BCS-BEC交叉的关键特征，且该交叉并非随载流子浓度降低而出现，而是在极窄掺杂范围（<1%）内随载流子浓度增加而突然发生。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和量子振荡（quantum oscillations）测量。

papers.title: A universal and efficient hybrid digital-analog fermionic quantum simulator
papers.abstract: We present a universal framework to harness fermionic ultracold atom platforms for quantum simulation, showing how variational algorithms on existing hardware can simulate many-body systems well beyond the hardware's native Hamiltonian. Our analysis provides evidence that one can quantum simulate the ground-state properties of a broad class of gapless target Hamiltonians of local observables in a quantum evolution time that grows polynomially with the inverse relative error, $T\sim O(\mathrm{poly}(1/ε))$ up to logarithmic corrections, offering an exponential speedup over na{ï}ve classical algorithms such as exact diagonalization. We provide numerical evidence and theoretical argument that this holds for energy density, density-density, and spin-spin correlations in three qualitatively distinct models -- the repulsive Hubbard model; a Hubbard model augmented with nearest-neighbor attractive interactions, which introduces the phenomenon of pairing; and the Hofstadter-Hubbard model, which introduces a gauge field and fractional quantum Hall physics. This work demonstrates quantum simulation using current fermionic platforms far beyond the models natively implemented in the hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：universal framework, theoretical argument, numerical evidence）；研究对象：基于超冷费米子平台的量子模拟器，用于模拟多体系统（如Hubbard模型、Hofstadter-Hubbard模型等）的基态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过变分算法，现有费米子量子模拟硬件可以高效模拟远超其原生哈密顿量的多体系统，且模拟时间随相对误差的倒数呈多项式增长（T~O(poly(1/ε))），相比经典精确对角化算法实现指数加速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过变分算法，现有费米子量子模拟硬件可以高效模拟远超其原生哈密顿量的多体系统，且模拟时间随相对误差的倒数呈多项式增长（T~O(poly(1/ε))），相比经典精确对角化算法实现指数加速。；创新点：展示了利用当前费米子平台模拟远超硬件原生哈密顿量的多体系统，并证明了在模拟无能隙目标哈密顿量基态性质时具有指数级加速潜力。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种通用的混合数字-模拟量子模拟框架，结合变分算法与超冷费米子平台，通过数值证据和理论论证分析能量密度、密度-密度和自旋-自旋关联函数在三种模型（排斥Hubbard模型、含近邻吸引相互作用的Hubbard模型、Hofstadter-Hubbard模型）中的表现。

papers.title: Complexity of the Laughlin wave function from the Dyson-orbital perspective
papers.abstract: The Fermi sea is a simple and common concept in physics. However, a related and equally simple concept -- the Dyson orbital -- is far less discussed in physics, especially in textbooks. Yet, Dyson orbitals offer a valuable tool for characterizing the complexity of a fermionic wave functions, particularly in distinguishing between Fermi-sea-like and non-Fermi-sea-like states. As a preliminary application, we examine the Laughlin wave function and find the fortunate fact that the Dyson orbitals can be determined analytically. Further numerical data provides \emph{quantitative} evidence that the Laughlin wave function describes a strongly correlated, non-Fermi liquid state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Dyson orbital”作为理论工具，并进行了“analytically”解析分析和“numerical data”数值计算，但未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：Laughlin波函数（描述分数量子霍尔效应的典型多体波函数），以及费米子波函数的复杂性分类（Fermi-sea-like与non-Fermi-sea-like状态）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从Dyson轨道视角出发，发现Laughlin波函数的Dyson轨道可解析求解；数值证据定量表明Laughlin波函数描述的是强关联的非费米液体态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从Dyson轨道视角出发，发现Laughlin波函数的Dyson轨道可解析求解；数值证据定量表明Laughlin波函数描述的是强关联的非费米液体态。；创新点：将Dyson轨道这一在物理教材中较少讨论的概念引入凝聚态物理，作为区分费米海态与非费米海态的新工具，并首次将其应用于Laughlin波函数的复杂性分析。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用Dyson轨道概念表征费米子波函数的复杂性；解析推导Laughlin波函数的Dyson轨道；辅以数值计算提供定量证据。

papers.title: Dissipation-coherence tradeoff for stochastic oscillations
papers.abstract: Autonomous noisy oscillations in biochemical and mesoscopic systems require nonequilibrium driving and therefore dissipation. A striking conjecture by Oberreiter, Barato, and Seifert (OBS) proposes a universal lower bound on the entropy produced per oscillation period in terms of the coherence number of the slowest oscillatory mode. Here we derive a weaker but rigorous lower bound that preserves the OBS structure while introducing a mode-uniformity factor that quantifies how evenly the oscillatory eigenmode is distributed across states in the steady-state inner product. The result makes explicit that an eigenvalue-only prefactor can fail when the dominant oscillatory mode is localized. We also outline a proof-of-principle route for estimating this factor from low-dimensional data under single-mode dominance and sufficiently informative measurements, and derive an eigenvector-free corollary using only the smallest stationary probability. Translation-invariant Markov jump processes on a ring provide a symmetry-protected class with $η=1$, so the refinement reduces to the OBS form; the drift--diffusion limit on a circle saturates the bound.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：推导解析下界、提出理论因子、进行数学证明。；研究对象：生化与介观系统中自发噪声振荡的耗散-相干性权衡关系，具体涉及熵产生率与振荡相干性的普适下界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一个比Oberreiter、Barato和Seifert（OBS）猜想更弱但严格的熵产生下界，该下界引入了一个“模式均匀性因子”，揭示了当主导振荡本征模局域化时，仅依赖本征值的预因子会失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一个比Oberreiter、Barato和Seifert（OBS）猜想更弱但严格的熵产生下界，该下界引入了一个“模式均匀性因子”，揭示了当主导振荡本征模局域化时，仅依赖本征值的预因子会失效。；创新点：首次明确指出了OBS猜想中本征值预因子在主导振荡模局域化情况下的局限性，并引入模式均匀性因子作为修正，同时给出了无需本征矢的推论（仅需最小稳态概率）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于稳态内积定义模式均匀性因子，修正OBS猜想的下界；利用平移不变马尔可夫跳变过程（环上）和圆上漂移-扩散极限进行对称性保护类验证；提出从低维数据估计该因子的原理性路径。

papers.title: Ideal Quantum Geometry for Fractional Chern Insulators
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry plays a fundamental role in many aspects of condensed matter physics. Among its central objects are the Berry curvature and the quantum metric -- quantities that, while distinct, are intertwined through geometric constraints. In this article, we survey recent progress in understanding when and how this bound is saturated, with particular emphasis on the emergence of momentum-space holomorphicity of Bloch states. These developments highlight a profound connection between certain ideal Bloch bands and the Hilbert space structure of the lowest Landau level. We elucidate this relationship through a review of quantum Hall physics in both homogeneous and spatially varying magnetic fields, and conclude by exploring its implications for the search for fractionalized phases in emerging platforms, including moiré materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：survey（综述）、review（回顾）、exploring implications（探讨意义），未提及实验或计算具体方法。；研究对象：分数陈绝缘体中的理想量子几何性质，特别是动量空间布洛赫态的全纯性，以及其与最低朗道能级希尔伯特空间结构的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了理想布洛赫带与最低朗道能级之间深刻的几何联系，并指出通过饱和贝里曲率与量子度量之间的几何约束（即实现动量空间布洛赫态的全纯性）是理解分数陈绝缘体相的关键。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了理想布洛赫带与最低朗道能级之间深刻的几何联系，并指出通过饱和贝里曲率与量子度量之间的几何约束（即实现动量空间布洛赫态的全纯性）是理解分数陈绝缘体相的关键。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但整体上系统整合了量子几何约束饱和与布洛赫态全纯性这一前沿视角，并明确将其与分数陈绝缘体的实现条件及实验平台（如moire材料）相关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论综述与概念分析。通过回顾均匀和空间变化磁场下的量子霍尔物理，系统梳理了量子几何约束饱和条件的研究进展，并探讨其对moire材料等新兴平台中分数量子相搜索的启示。

papers.title: Realistic quantum device data synthesized by consumer AI and how to identify it
papers.abstract: With the advance of generative artificial intelligence (AI) synthetic texts and images have become commonplace. These capabilities offer clear benefits, but have also raised a number of ethical concerns that often have to do with misrepresenting AI outputs as genuine material. A lesser known capability of generative AI is to perform the basic analysis, processing and even synthesis of numerical data. This raises the question of whether AI can be used to imitate experimental data that an expert would consider scientifically meaningful and on par with data in the figures of peer-reviewed manuscripts? In this paper, we focus on synthesizing data inspired by well-known experiments done frequently on quantum electronic devices. This field is related to information technologies such as spintronics and quantum computing, and is considered data-rich and data-driven. We demonstrate that it is possible to generate dramatic signals associated with iconic effects such as quantum bit control, Majorana fermions, Josephson effects, quantum dots and wires using widely available ChatGPT. We find that because some of the clearest data from quantum devices can be expressed in terms of relatively basic mathematical models, AI does not need to learn on the specialized body of data. Instead, knowledge of the physics equations and of the basic features of experimental signals can go a long way towards building a realistic dataset. We also demonstrate that real data can be augmented by AI, and that AI can mimic the noise of common scientific instruments. To help assure that published data come from experiments and are not synthesized by AI, we recommend sharing large volumes of the primary data. While it is straightforward for AI to mimic a few sets of data, consistently generating long measured sequences poses sufficient barriers to the proliferation of undisclosed synthetic data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（包含数据合成实验与数据分析/鉴别方法）。判断依据：摘要中提及“合成数据”“模仿实验数据”“推荐共享原始数据”等，既有生成式AI模拟实验数据的实践，也有对数据真实性的鉴别建议。；研究对象：量子电子器件中的典型实验数据，包括量子比特控制、马约拉纳费米子、约瑟夫森效应、量子点和量子线等体系产生的信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用广泛可用的ChatGPT等生成式AI，能够合成与量子器件经典效应（如量子比特控制、马约拉纳费米子等）相关的逼真实验信号，且由于这些信号可用基础数学模型表达，AI无需专门学习实验数据即可生成。同时，AI还能模拟常见科学仪器的噪声。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用广泛可用的ChatGPT等生成式AI，能够合成与量子器件经典效应（如量子比特控制、马约拉纳费米子等）相关的逼真实验信号，且由于这些信号可用基础数学模型表达，AI无需专门学习实验数据即可生成。同时，AI还能模拟常见科学仪器的噪声。；创新点：揭示了生成式AI在合成数值实验数据方面的能力，特别是针对量子电子器件领域，指出其可基于基础物理模型而非专用数据集生成逼真信号，并提出了鉴别合成数据的实用建议（共享大量原始数据）。摘要未突出说明与已有鉴别方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 使用生成式AI（具体为ChatGPT）基于物理方程和实验信号基本特征，合成量子电子器件实验数据；通过对比真实数据与AI合成数据，分析其可鉴别性；提出通过共享大量原始数据来防止未公开的合成数据泛滥。

papers.title: Interplay of non-local transport and local scattering during electron thermalization and spatial equilibration in laser-excited metals
papers.abstract: Ultrafast laser excitation of metals induces electronic nonequilibrium both in space and locally in the energy distribution. The subsequent dynamics are governed by the interplay between non-local transport and local scattering of hot electrons, yet combined microscopic descriptions of these processes remain sparse. Here, we disentangle the influence of these processes on thermalization using a reformulation of the Boltzmann transport equation in energy space that consistently describes both spatial equilibration and scattering through full collision integrals. Our results reveal that transport accelerates the apparent thermalization observed at the irradiated surface by removing athermal carriers, while the same spatial redistribution delays complete equilibration of the full electron system. We analyze the experimentally accessible energy-dependent dynamics at the front and back surface and find that the dominant process varies, depending on both position and on the energetic window. Overall, our work improves the understanding of the interplay of electronic nonequilibrium processes occurring in optically thick laser-driven systems with relevant implications for future electronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Boltzmann transport equation reformulation, full collision integrals, microscopic description。；研究对象：激光激发金属中电子非平衡态的热化与空间平衡化过程，具体关注非局域输运与局域散射之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非局域输运通过移除非热载流子加速了辐照表面观测到的表观热化，但同一空间再分布过程却延迟了整个电子系统的完全平衡化。主导过程随位置和能量窗口变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非局域输运通过移除非热载流子加速了辐照表面观测到的表观热化，但同一空间再分布过程却延迟了整个电子系统的完全平衡化。主导过程随位置和能量窗口变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于玻尔兹曼输运方程在能量空间中的重新表述，通过完整的碰撞积分一致地描述空间平衡化与散射过程。

papers.title: A nanoscale magnetic spectrum analyzer based on qubit dressed states
papers.abstract: Magnetic field fluctuations on nanometer length scales manifest in a diverse range of phenomena -- electron and spin dynamics in materials and devices, quantum many-body systems, and molecular chemistry. Measuring these phenomena requires sensors with a challenging combination of broad spectral bandwidth, high sensitivity, and nanoscale spatial resolution. Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers, atom-like quantum sensors in diamond, possess the requisite sensitivity and nanoscale sensing volume, but are typically limited in bandwidth by the practical speed of the applied quantum control sequence. Here, we overcome this limitation by exposing the NV qubit to a microwave dressing field during a dynamical decoupling sequence, which both amplifies and frequency-mixes target signals at arbitrary frequencies into the detection band of the dynamical decoupling protocol. We demonstrate this approach by using NV centers to detect both coherent and noisy nanoscale spin wave dynamics in a magnetic yttrium-iron-garnet (YIG) thin film over a broad frequency range. Our technique generalizes to other qubit platforms, providing a versatile framework for nanoscale spectroscopy across diverse physical and chemical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验方法（“exposing the NV qubit to a microwave dressing field during a dynamical decoupling sequence”）和实验演示（“using NV centers to detect... spin wave dynamics”）。；研究对象：基于氮-空位（NV）中心的纳米尺度磁频谱分析仪，具体用于检测钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜中的自旋波动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将NV量子比特暴露于微波修饰场中，可以克服传统NV中心在频谱带宽上的限制，实现对任意频率的相干和噪声纳米尺度自旋波信号的宽频检测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将NV量子比特暴露于微波修饰场中，可以克服传统NV中心在频谱带宽上的限制，实现对任意频率的相干和噪声纳米尺度自旋波信号的宽频检测。；创新点：提出了一种利用量子比特修饰态来扩展NV中心频谱检测带宽的通用方法，突破了传统量子控制序列速度对带宽的限制，并首次将该技术应用于检测YIG薄膜中的宽频自旋波动力学。
papers.method_zh: 采用动态去耦序列结合微波修饰场（dressing field）技术，对目标信号进行放大和频率混频，使其进入动态去耦协议的检测频带。实验上使用NV中心作为量子传感器。

papers.title: Fermiology and the Candidate Chiral Superconductor in Rhombohedral Tetralayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Chiral superconductivity, in which the phase of the superconducting order parameter winds in momentum space, has long been sought for its close link to topological superconductivity. Recent work reported a superconductor in rhombohedral multilayer graphene emerging from a time-reversal symmetry broken normal state, suggesting that it could be a chiral superconductor. However, the possibility of chirality depends on the symmetry and structure of the normal-state Fermi surface, which have not been directly measured. Here we measure quantum oscillations in rhombohedral tetralayer graphene over a broad range of the phase diagram, including the superconducting region. At densities well above the onset of superconductivity, we reproduce previously-reported oscillations consistent with a spin- and valley-polarized quarter metal with a single simply-connected Fermi pocket. As the carrier density is reduced, we find a transition to a complex "multitone" state that persists through the superconducting region. This state's spectrum of quantum oscillations is incompatible with a simply-connected quarter metal. The next-simplest candidate normal states suggested by our microscopic modeling (fully-polarized annular, nematic, and three-pocket states) are inconsistent with our measurements, albeit difficult to rule out entirely. The normal state is thus seen to be richer than previously envisaged, reshaping the search for the superconducting mechanism and the possible chirality of the pairing channel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：measure quantum oscillations, reproduce previously-reported oscillations, find a transition）；研究对象：菱方堆垛四层石墨烯（Rhombohedral Tetralayer Graphene）中的超导态及其正常态费米面结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱方四层石墨烯的超导区域，正常态并非之前认为的简单单连通四分之一金属，而是一个更复杂的“多频”态。这一发现重塑了对该体系中超导机制及配对通道可能具有手性的理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱方四层石墨烯的超导区域，正常态并非之前认为的简单单连通四分之一金属，而是一个更复杂的“多频”态。这一发现重塑了对该体系中超导机制及配对通道可能具有手性的理解。；创新点：首次直接测量了菱方多层石墨烯超导区域内的正常态费米面结构，揭示了其复杂性，并排除了此前被广泛接受的简单单连通费米口袋模型。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 通过测量量子振荡（quantum oscillations），覆盖了包括超导区域在内的相图大范围，并结合微观建模（microscopic modeling）对候选正常态进行比对分析。

papers.title: Opinion dynamics on social proximity disordered networks
papers.abstract: Understanding how local social pressure shapes collective opinion formation is essential in modern society, with implications in sociology, politics, finance, and technology. Complex networks are a powerful framework for investigating these processes and for representing social interactions in emergent phenomena, and canonical models such as random, scale-free, and small-world networks remain most relevant when Euclidean geometric proximity and contiguous interactions are not the dominant organizing factors. Our investigation explores the effects of Gabriel graphs, a spatially embedded network that utilizes proximity-based interactions, on social opinion dynamics. Using a geometric disorder parameter that randomly displaces agent coordinates, we transition from square lattices of social interactions to spatial random networks that preserve local constraints while introducing strong topological heterogeneity. Opinion dynamics operate through social pressure, with a level of nonconformity that affects dissent among opinions. We analyze magnetization, susceptibility, and Binder's fourth-order cumulant to characterize the emergence and breakdown of global social consensus. The model exhibits second-order phase transitions whose behavior depends on both geometric disorder and nonconformity levels. We use volumetric scaling and provide a reference frame appropriate for characterizing criticality in regular and heterogeneous interaction topologies. We find that the standard critical exponents remain compatible with the two-dimensional Ising universality class. Furthermore, the results suggest that spatially constrained, planar, and globally connected interaction topologies preserve the dimensionality of space in critical dynamics analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用“Gabriel图”构建网络模型，并进行了“磁化率、磁化强度、Binder四阶累积量”等统计物理量的计算与分析，属于计算模拟和理论分析范畴。；研究对象：社会舆论动力学，具体研究在基于空间邻近性（Gabriel图）构建的社交网络中，几何无序和非从众性如何影响集体共识的形成与瓦解。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型表现出二级相变，其临界行为与二维伊辛模型属于同一普适类。结果表明，空间受限、平面且全局连通的相互作用拓扑结构在临界动力学分析中保留了空间的维度性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型表现出二级相变，其临界行为与二维伊辛模型属于同一普适类。结果表明，空间受限、平面且全局连通的相互作用拓扑结构在临界动力学分析中保留了空间的维度性。；创新点：将空间嵌入网络（Gabriel图）与几何无序参数相结合，系统地研究了从规则晶格到空间随机网络这一连续变化过程中，拓扑异质性对舆论动力学临界行为的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用Gabriel图构建空间嵌入网络，并通过几何无序参数随机扰动代理坐标，实现从规则方格到空间随机网络的过渡。使用社会压力模型模拟舆论动力学，并引入非从众性参数。通过计算磁化强度、磁化率、Binder四阶累积量等统计量，并利用体积缩放分析临界指数。

papers.title: Hydrogen-induced lattice cohesion weakening favors atomic displacement
papers.abstract: Atomic displacement -- the fundamental process underlying diverse deformation and damage phenomena in metals, from irradiation defect production to stress-driven dislocation motion -- is governed by interatomic cohesion strength. Here, lattice-dissolved hydrogen (LDH) occurring in metals under direct hydrogen exposure is identified to effectively weaken lattice cohesion, and thereby facilitating atomic displacement and dislocation movement upon plastic deformation in sub-threshold stress regime. This atomic-scale insight provides a physically transparent mechanism for hydrogen-enhanced localized plasticity implicated in hydrogen embrittlement. We quantitatively verify the hydrogen-induced lattice cohesion weakening effect on metal surfaces exposed to low-energy hydrogen plasma, where massive defects are generated despite the absence of sufficient ion momentum for direct displacement damage. By unprecedentedly quantifying the cohesion-weakening effect of LDH independently from defect-trapped H, we establish a new paradigm to understand hydrogen embrittlement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中提出“氢诱导晶格内聚弱化”的物理机制，并通过低能氢等离子体暴露实验进行定量验证，属于理论机制与实验验证的混合类型。；研究对象：金属中氢诱导的晶格内聚弱化效应及其对原子位移和位错运动的影响，具体涉及氢脆现象中的氢增强局部塑性机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶格溶解氢（LDH）能有效削弱金属晶格内聚强度，从而在亚阈值应力条件下促进原子位移和位错运动，为氢脆中的氢增强局部塑性提供了原子尺度的物理机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶格溶解氢（LDH）能有效削弱金属晶格内聚强度，从而在亚阈值应力条件下促进原子位移和位错运动，为氢脆中的氢增强局部塑性提供了原子尺度的物理机制。；创新点：首次独立于缺陷捕获氢，定量表征了晶格溶解氢（LDH）对晶格内聚的弱化效应，建立了理解氢脆的新范式。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合低能氢等离子体暴露实验，通过独立量化晶格溶解氢（而非缺陷捕获氢）的内聚弱化效应，验证了该机制。

papers.title: Magnetochiral anisotropy in strained superconducting transition metal dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study of nonreciprocal charge transport in two-dimensional noncentrosymmetric superconductors, focusing on transition-metal dichalcogenide MoS$_2$ as a representative example. In the normal state, the electrical response of a material to the relative orientation of the current and magnetic field is suppressed to leading order in the symmetry-breaking perturbations. In the vicinity of the superconducting transition, magnetochiral anisotropy is strongly enhanced. We consider contributions to the nonreciprocal current originating from order-parameter fluctuations and quantum-interference processes. These terms are linked to higher-order Lifshitz invariants generically allowed in the Ginzburg-Landau free energy of superconductors with broken inversion and time-reversal symmetries. We further show that strain enables additional vector components in the nonlinear current response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We present a theoretical study”（我们提出一项理论研究），并讨论了基于Ginzburg-Landau自由能的理论框架。；研究对象：二维非中心对称超导体中的非互易电荷输运现象，具体以过渡金属二硫族化物MoS₂为代表材料。研究聚焦于磁手性各向异性（Magnetochiral anisotropy）在超导转变附近的增强效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超导转变附近，磁手性各向异性（即电流与磁场相对取向导致的非互易输运）会显著增强。这种增强来源于序参量涨落和量子干涉过程，它们与Ginzburg-Landau自由能中允许的高阶Lifshitz不变量相关。此外，应变可以引入非线性电流响应中的额外矢量分量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超导转变附近，磁手性各向异性（即电流与磁场相对取向导致的非互易输运）会显著增强。这种增强来源于序参量涨落和量子干涉过程，它们与Ginzburg-Landau自由能中允许的高阶Lifshitz不变量相关。此外，应变可以引入非线性电流响应中的额外矢量分量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体区别，但创新点可能在于：1）将超导转变附近的磁手性各向异性增强归因于高阶Lifshitz不变量；2）揭示了应变作为调控手段，能够引入非线性电流响应中新的矢量分量。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架包括：基于对称性分析讨论正常态下的电响应；利用Ginzburg-Landau理论，考虑破缺反演对称性和时间反演对称性下的高阶Lifshitz不变量；分析序参量涨落和量子干涉过程对非互易电流的贡献。

papers.title: Breakdown of Thermalization from Real-Time Dynamics in the Two-Dimensional Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: Thermalization in strongly correlated fermionic systems remains a central open problem in quantum many-body physics. In this work, we investigate the real-time dynamics and the approach to thermalization in the two-dimensional Hubbard model, a paradigmatic framework for correlated electrons, relevant to high-temperature superconductivity and ultracold quantum simulation. Focusing on the half-filled square lattice, we monitor the time evolution of the double occupancy following a quench in the on-site interaction $U$, and assess whether its long-time value is captured by a canonical thermal ensemble. We employ time-dependent variational Monte Carlo methods combined with transformer-based Neural-Network Quantum States to accurately describe the nonequilibrium dynamics of fermions, especially for the behavior at long times, thereby accessing regimes that were previously inaccessible to numerical simulations. Our results reveal two distinct dynamical behaviors: for weak to intermediate interactions, the long-time double occupancy agrees with the thermal prediction, consistent with ergodic relaxation; beyond a critical interaction $U_{C}$, the dynamics deviate markedly from the thermal expectation, revealing clear signatures of thermalization breaking. These results establish numerical simulation as a powerful tool to probe nonequilibrium quantum phenomena in correlated fermionic matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：time-dependent variational Monte Carlo methods、Neural-Network Quantum States、numerical simulation。；研究对象：二维哈伯德模型（two-dimensional Hubbard model）在半填充正方晶格上的非平衡动力学与热化行为，该模型与高温超导和超冷量子模拟相关。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱到中等相互作用强度下，长时间双占据数符合热化预期（遍历弛豫）；当相互作用强度超过临界值 \( U_C \) 时，动力学行为明显偏离热化预期，表明热化被打破。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱到中等相互作用强度下，长时间双占据数符合热化预期（遍历弛豫）；当相互作用强度超过临界值 \( U_C \) 时，动力学行为明显偏离热化预期，表明热化被打破。；创新点：利用神经网络量子态方法首次实现了对二维哈伯德模型在强关联区域长时间非平衡动力学的数值模拟，揭示了此前数值方法无法触及的热化破缺临界行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时变分蒙特卡洛方法（time-dependent variational Monte Carlo methods）结合基于Transformer的神经网络量子态（transformer-based Neural-Network Quantum States），以精确描述费米子的非平衡动力学，特别是长时间行为。

papers.title: Magnetic-field driven hybridization of heavy- and light-hole Rydberg excitons in GaAs quantum wells
papers.abstract: We present a combined theoretical and experimental study of ground and excited Rydberg exciton states in wide GaAs quantum wells exposed to a magnetic field in the Faraday geometry. We employ a multiband exciton model based on the Luttinger Hamiltonian, which captures valence-band mixing between heavy- and light-hole states induced by both the quantum well confinement and the magnetic field, and we develop an efficient numerical approach to solve for both ground- and excited-state excitons. The method treats Coulomb interactions, magnetic confinement, and band mixing on an equal footing, enabling a systematic characterization of exciton energies, oscillator strengths, and orbital composition. We show that band hybridization increases with magnetic field and is significantly more pronounced for higher excited states, where it sets in at lower fields and strongly modifies their properties. The theoretical predictions are validated by polarization-resolved magneto-reflectance measurements up to 9 T on GaAs/Al$_{0.4}$Ga$_{0.6}$As quantum wells of 20 nm width. We find excellent agreement for both the diamagnetic shift and Zeeman splitting of the ground state and the first four Rydberg excitons. Our results demonstrate that valence-band mixing plays a crucial role in determining the magnetic-field dependence of excited exciton states and must be properly included for a quantitative description of magneto-excitons in wide GaAs quantum wells.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。关键词：combined theoretical and experimental study、multiband exciton model、polarization-resolved magneto-reflectance measurements。；研究对象：宽GaAs量子阱中重空穴和轻空穴里德伯激子（Rydberg excitons）在磁场（法拉第几何）下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁场会增强重空穴与轻空穴的能带杂化，且对高激发态激子影响更显著（在更低磁场下即发生并强烈改变其性质）；价带混合对激子激发态的磁场依赖性起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁场会增强重空穴与轻空穴的能带杂化，且对高激发态激子影响更显著（在更低磁场下即发生并强烈改变其性质）；价带混合对激子激发态的磁场依赖性起关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：基于Luttinger哈密顿量的多能带激子模型，将库仑相互作用、磁场约束和能带混合同等处理，并开发了高效数值方法求解基态和激发态激子。实验方面：对20 nm宽GaAs/Al₀.₄Ga₀.₆As量子阱进行偏振分辨磁反射谱测量（磁场最高9 T）。

papers.title: Nambu Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics and the Lyapunov Structure of Open Systems
papers.abstract: In open nonequilibrium systems, the thermodynamic entropy of a subsystem is not generally a Lyapunov function. Even during relaxation toward equilibrium, it may decrease temporarily because of exchanges with external reservoirs. This raises a basic question: what thermodynamic quantity, if any, organizes irreversible relaxation in an open system? We address this question using an explicit open-piston model coupled to both a pressure reservoir and a heat bath. The reversible sector is formulated as a Nambu rotational flow generated by the extended energy and the subsystem entropy, while the irreversible sector is written as a gradient flow generated by a dissipation potential $S_{NB}$. In the adiabatic reversible limit, the Nambu bracket produces the oscillatory piston motion on the intersection of conserved level surfaces. After coupling to a heat bath and adding friction, the subsystem entropy $S$ can exhibit nonmonotonic oscillations, whereas $S_{NB}=S-H_{1}/T_{b}$ increases monotonically under the proposed positive-semidefinite dissipative structure. We show that this monotonicity is not a consequence of identifying $S_{NB}$ with thermodynamic entropy. Rather, it follows from two geometric conditions: the reversible Nambu flow preserves $S_{NB}$, and the irreversible dynamics can be written as a positive-semidefinite gradient flow generated by $S_{NB}$. The open-piston model therefore provides a minimal macroscopic realization in which thermodynamic entropy, dissipation potential, reversible temporal order, and irreversible relaxation can be separated explicitly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“formulated as”“written as”“proposed”等理论构建词汇，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：开放非平衡系统中的热力学弛豫过程，具体以“开放活塞模型”（open-piston model）为研究对象，该模型同时耦合压力库和热库。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在开放非平衡系统中，子系统熵并非李雅普诺夫函数，但构造的耗散势 \( S_{NB} = S - H_1 / T_b \) 在正半定耗散结构下单调递增，从而为开放系统的不可逆弛豫提供了组织性热力学量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在开放非平衡系统中，子系统熵并非李雅普诺夫函数，但构造的耗散势 \( S_{NB} = S - H_1 / T_b \) 在正半定耗散结构下单调递增，从而为开放系统的不可逆弛豫提供了组织性热力学量。；创新点：明确将开放系统的可逆时间顺序与不可逆弛豫分离，并指出 \( S_{NB} \) 的单调性并非源于其被识别为热力学熵，而是源于两个几何条件：可逆Nambu流保持 \( S_{NB} \) 不变，且不可逆动力学可写为由 \( S_{NB} \) 生成的正半定梯度流。
papers.method_zh: 采用Nambu非平衡热力学框架，将可逆部分表述为由扩展能量和子系统熵生成的Nambu旋转流，不可逆部分表述为由耗散势 \( S_{NB} \) 生成的梯度流，并分析绝热可逆极限与耦合热库后的摩擦动力学。

papers.title: Superconducting Triple Point in UTe$_2$: Thermodynamics and Symmetry
papers.abstract: Three lines of second-order phase transitions between the normal phase and two distinct superconducting phases meet at a single point on the phase diagram of UTe$_2$. Contrary to common belief, there are no thermodynamic constraints for such triple points. The phase diagram is interpreted within Landau theory in terms of two superconducting order parameters with different gauge symmetries. Such an interpretation is unique under the assumption of spatial uniformity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Landau theory”（朗道理论）作为理论框架，并基于热力学和对称性分析进行解释。；研究对象：UTe₂超导体中的三相点（triple point），即正常相与两个不同超导相之间的三条二级相变线交汇的单一相图点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在UTe₂的相图中，正常相与两个不同超导相之间的三条二级相变线可以交汇于一个三相点，且不存在热力学约束禁止这种三相点的存在。该相图可通过具有不同规范对称性的两个超导序参量的朗道理论唯一解释（在空间均匀性假设下）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在UTe₂的相图中，正常相与两个不同超导相之间的三条二级相变线可以交汇于一个三相点，且不存在热力学约束禁止这种三相点的存在。该相图可通过具有不同规范对称性的两个超导序参量的朗道理论唯一解释（在空间均匀性假设下）。；创新点：推翻了“三相点不能由二级相变线交汇而成”的普遍认知，证明了在UTe₂中这种热力学约束并不存在，并给出了基于对称性的唯一理论解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用朗道相变理论（Landau theory）进行热力学和对称性分析，基于两个超导序参量构建相图，并检验三相点的热力学可行性。

papers.title: Energy-Modulated Time-Asymmetric Spontaneous Collapse: Forward-Backward Dynamics from Stochastic Ito Reversal and Bright Solitons
papers.abstract: We present a rigorous theoretical framework for symmetry breaking and quantum irreversibility arising from stochastic Ito field reversal within a cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrodinger equation (CQ-NLSE) formalism. Starting from three physically motivated considerations, forward and backward nonlinear stochastic differential equations are derived via the Ito calculus. Kinematic time-reversal is shown to be fundamentally incompatible with the Ito stochastic structure, yielding the universal asymmetry-coupling parameter of 2/3. An energy-driven collapse operator proportional to the product of noise strength, local probability density, and excitation energy squared is introduced, amplifying the collapse in high-density, high-excitation regions. Exactly bright soliton solutions are obtained for a quasi-one-dimensional BEC of attractive Li-7 atoms, with forward and backward amplitude ratio of 1.870. Heat map analysis of the parameter planes reveals that the forward collapse operator grows monotonically in time while the backward counterpart decays, achieving a ratio approximately 1030, sharply distinguishing this framework from conventional symmetric collapse models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“rigorous theoretical framework”“derived via the Ito calculus”“exactly bright soliton solutions are obtained”，属于纯理论推导与解析求解。；研究对象：基于立方-五次非线性薛定谔方程（CQ-NLSE）的量子不可逆性与对称破缺，具体应用于准一维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的吸引性锂-7（Li-7）原子体系，以及由此产生的亮孤子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个能量调制的、时间不对称的自发坍缩理论框架，其中前向与后向动力学由随机伊藤反转驱动，并获得了振幅比为1.870的精确亮孤子解；前向坍缩算符随时间单调增长，后向则衰减，两者比值可达约10^30，显著区别于传统对称坍缩模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个能量调制的、时间不对称的自发坍缩理论框架，其中前向与后向动力学由随机伊藤反转驱动，并获得了振幅比为1.870的精确亮孤子解；前向坍缩算符随时间单调增长，后向则衰减，两者比值可达约10^30，显著区别于传统对称坍缩模型。；创新点：揭示了伊藤随机结构与运动学时间反演的根本不相容性，从而自然导出普适的不对称耦合参数2/3；提出了能量调制的、时间不对称的坍缩机制，使得前向与后向动力学产生巨大差异（比值达10^30量级），突破了传统对称坍缩模型的框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用伊藤微积分（Ito calculus）推导前向与后向非线性随机微分方程；引入能量驱动的坍缩算符（正比于噪声强度、局域概率密度和激发能平方）；通过解析求解获得准一维BEC中亮孤子的精确解，并利用参数平面热图分析坍缩算符的时间演化行为。

papers.title: Reliability of asymptotic work extraction
papers.abstract: Extracting work from quantum states is a fundamental task in quantum thermodynamics. Previous studies have primarily focused on determining the best achievable rate of work extraction, and remarkably, this characterization appeared to remain unchanged regardless of the choice of allowed processes: whether one considers the operationally motivated class of energy-conserving thermal operations, or the axiomatic class of Gibbs-preserving operations, the optimal extractable work is given by the Helmholtz free energy. Here, we challenge this perspective, showing that a more refined analysis of the asymptotic performance of work extraction reveals significant differences in the performance for the two different classes of free operations. Precisely, we focus on the trade-off between the extraction rate and its reliability, characterized by the optimal asymptotic speed at which the extraction error can be suppressed. We establish that the reliability of Gibbs-preserving operations and of thermal operations are respectively characterized by the Petz and the sandwiched Rényi relative entropies, demonstrating that the former in general strictly outperforms the latter, and providing new interpretations of several information-theoretic divergences. Our analysis reveals that operational constraints such as energy conservation impose stronger limitations on the achievable precision of quantum tasks than can be inferred from their asymptotic rates, thereby questioning the use of Gibbs-preserving operations as a mathematically convenient substitute for the physically realizable thermal processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：asymptotic work extraction、quantum thermodynamics、Rényi relative entropies、operational constraints。；研究对象：量子热力学中的功提取过程，具体比较两类自由操作（能量守恒的热操作与公理化的吉布斯保持操作）在渐近极限下的性能差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在功提取的渐近性能分析中，吉布斯保持操作在抑制提取误差的可靠性上严格优于热操作；能量守恒等操作约束对量子任务精度的限制比仅从渐近速率推断的更严格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在功提取的渐近性能分析中，吉布斯保持操作在抑制提取误差的可靠性上严格优于热操作；能量守恒等操作约束对量子任务精度的限制比仅从渐近速率推断的更严格。；创新点：首次揭示在渐近功提取中，两类自由操作在可靠性（误差抑制速度）上存在本质差异，并给出新的信息论散度解释，质疑了用吉布斯保持操作替代物理热操作的数学便利性。
papers.method_zh: 采用信息论与量子热力学框架，通过Ptz Rényi相对熵和夹层Rényi相对熵分别刻画两类操作的可靠性，并分析提取速率与误差抑制速度之间的权衡关系。

papers.title: Early psychosis shows deviations in scaling behaviour within a critical regime
papers.abstract: Accumulating evidence suggests that large-scale brain activity exhibits scale-invariant dynamics consistent with operation in a near-critical regime. Such dynamics have been associated with long-range correlations, efficient information processing, and the emergence of collective organization. While altered criticality-related measures have been reported in psychiatric disorders, previous findings remain fragmented across observables and modalities, making it unclear whether different scaling measures capture a common alteration of large-scale brain dynamics. Here, we investigated scaling properties in resting-state fMRI data from individuals with early psychosis and healthy controls. We combined a phenomenological renormalization group (PRG) framework with power spectral density (PSD) and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) to characterize collective dynamics across scales. In healthy controls, resting-state activity exhibited non-trivial scaling behavior consistent with critical-like organization. Early psychosis participants showed the same overall phenomenology of scale-invariant organization, but with systematic shifts in scaling exponents across multiple observables. These findings indicate that early psychosis is not characterized by a simple loss of critical-like dynamics, but rather by a reorganization of collective dynamics within a preserved scaling regime. More broadly, our results suggest that combining coarse-graining approaches with temporal scaling analyses provides a principled framework for studying large-scale brain dynamics in psychiatric disorders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论分析文章。判断依据：结合了现象学重整化群（PRG）框架、功率谱密度（PSD）和去趋势波动分析（DFA）对fMRI数据进行计算分析，属于数据驱动的理论建模与标度行为研究。；研究对象：早期精神病患者（early psychosis）与健康对照组的静息态功能磁共振成像（resting-state fMRI）数据，研究大脑大规模活动的标度行为（scaling behavior）与临界动力学（critical dynamics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 早期精神病并非简单地丧失临界样动力学，而是在保留的标度区间内，集体动力学发生了重组，表现为多个观测量的标度指数出现系统性偏移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：早期精神病并非简单地丧失临界样动力学，而是在保留的标度区间内，集体动力学发生了重组，表现为多个观测量的标度指数出现系统性偏移。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合现象学重整化群（PRG）框架、功率谱密度（PSD）和去趋势波动分析（DFA），对跨尺度的集体动力学进行表征。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium thermodynamics of collapse models in the strongly non-Gaussian regime
papers.abstract: Standard objective collapse models offer a unified approach to the quantum measurement problem but predict an unphysical, indefinite increase in the energy of the system. The dissipative Diósi-Penrose (dDP) model resolves this heating issue by introducing a linear friction mechanism. However, this modification induces complex, non-Gaussian phase-space dynamics. We rigorously establish the thermodynamic consistency of this friction mechanism -- extended to the CSL model -- across both weakly and strongly non-Gaussian regimes. Using the Wigner phase-space formalism, we go significantly beyond the quadratic approximation and, to bypass the failure of perturbative methods under strong dissipation, introduce a novel exact pseudo-spectral simulation approach. Our analysis reveals that the system subjected to the dDP mechanism does not thermalize, but rather settles into a non-equilibrium steady-state (NESS) where the asymptotic non-Gaussianity scales as the third power of the dissipation parameter $β$. By evaluating the Wigner entropy production, we confirm the thermodynamic validity of the model and demonstrate that highly sensitive information-theoretic quantities require exact numerical methods to accurately capture the key non-Gaussian tails of the distribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Wigner phase-space formalism”、“exact pseudo-spectral simulation approach”等理论框架和数值方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的是客观坍缩模型（objective collapse models）中的非平衡热力学，具体针对耗散型Diósi-Penrose（dDP）模型及其扩展到CSL模型后的非高斯相空间动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耗散（强非高斯）区域，dDP机制下的系统不会热化，而是进入一个非平衡稳态（NESS），其渐近非高斯性随耗散参数β的三次方标度。通过Wigner熵产生率验证了该模型的热力学一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耗散（强非高斯）区域，dDP机制下的系统不会热化，而是进入一个非平衡稳态（NESS），其渐近非高斯性随耗散参数β的三次方标度。通过Wigner熵产生率验证了该模型的热力学一致性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Wigner相空间形式论（超越二次近似），并引入一种新的精确伪谱模拟方法（exact pseudo-spectral simulation approach）以规避强耗散下微扰方法的失效。

papers.title: Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling
papers.abstract: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the \texttt{softmax} temperature $T$ and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic $T_c$ with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below $T_c$. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near $T_c$. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：统计场框架、连续自旋变量、序参量、标度行为。；研究对象：大型语言模型（LLM）文本生成过程中的温度缩放行为，将其类比为统计物理中的连续相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在softmax温度T接近特征温度T_c时，观察到磁化率出现尖锐峰值并伴随幂律标度行为，序参量发生快速变化，且嵌入场在T_c以下坍缩至单一语义方向，这些现象与连续相变高度相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在softmax温度T接近特征温度T_c时，观察到磁化率出现尖锐峰值并伴随幂律标度行为，序参量发生快速变化，且嵌入场在T_c以下坍缩至单一语义方向，这些现象与连续相变高度相似。；创新点：首次将统计场理论框架系统应用于LLM文本生成的温度缩放行为，揭示了温度参数与临界现象之间的定量联系，并提供了探测LLM输出集体统计结构的量化工具。
papers.method_zh: 将token嵌入视为一维链上的连续自旋变量，定义基于连通两点关联函数的磁化率和基于系综平均嵌入场的序参量，通过改变softmax温度T进行数值模拟，并利用最近邻（TwoNN）方法估计本征维度进行独立验证。

papers.title: Flapping instability of elastic disks in Stokes flows
papers.abstract: Fluid-structure interactions at low Reynolds number can lead to a much richer phenomenology than previously expected. Here, we study the dynamics of a freely suspended, thin elastic disk in a shear flow, where the plane of the disk is initially parallel to the flow plane. Using a combination of experiments and simulations, we demonstrate that beyond a critical flow strength the disk deforms, performing flapping dynamics, in which the disk curves up and down periodically relative to the horizontal shear plane. The bifurcation diagram obtained by simulation reveals several oscillatory solutions, including a wiggling motion that is predicted by a linear stability analysis. The flapping dynamics is shown to be a subcritical instability whose key ingredient is the finite extensibility of the disk. The behavior we observe has implications for emerging investigations on the flow dynamics of sheet-like particles, such as 2D polymers and 2D crystalline materials immersed in viscous fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。关键词：experiments and simulations、linear stability analysis、bifurcation diagram。；研究对象：低雷诺数剪切流中自由悬浮的薄弹性圆盘（弹性圆盘在斯托克斯流中的扑动不稳定性）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当流动强度超过临界值时，弹性圆盘会发生周期性上下弯曲的扑动动力学行为，这是一种亚临界不稳定性，其关键机制是圆盘的有限可伸展性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当流动强度超过临界值时，弹性圆盘会发生周期性上下弯曲的扑动动力学行为，这是一种亚临界不稳定性，其关键机制是圆盘的有限可伸展性。；创新点：揭示了低雷诺数流固耦合中此前未被预期的丰富现象，特别是发现了弹性圆盘在剪切流中的扑动不稳定性及其亚临界特性，并指出有限可伸展性是关键因素。该发现对片状颗粒（如二维聚合物、二维晶体材料）在粘性流体中的流动动力学研究具有启示意义。
papers.method_zh: 实验观测与数值模拟相结合，并辅以线性稳定性分析来预测摆动运动，通过模拟获得分岔图。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Theory of LoRA Fine-Tuning in a Solvable Attention Model
papers.abstract: We develop a high-dimensional statistical theory of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in attention models, capturing the interplay between pre-training and fine-tuning. We introduce a solvable framework in which a single-head attention layer is first pre-trained on a data-abundant task and subsequently adapted via a rank-one LoRA update on limited data. In the high-dimensional limit, both stages admit a sharp asymptotic characterization in terms of a finite set of order parameters, yielding explicit predictions for test errors and representation alignment. Our analysis shows that the impact of pre-training on LoRA is summarized by an effective noise term, from which we derive prescriptions for the optimal pre-training procedure. We also demonstrate a regime with a mismatch between the value of the test error and representation quality, and propose an application of our theory to active fine-tuning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：high-dimensional statistical theory、solvable framework、sharp asymptotic characterization。；研究对象：注意力模型（attention model）中低秩适应（LoRA）微调的高维统计理论，具体研究单头注意力层在预训练和微调两个阶段的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预训练对LoRA微调的影响可归结为一个有效噪声项，据此可推导最优预训练策略；存在测试误差与表示质量不匹配的参数区间，并提出了主动微调的应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预训练对LoRA微调的影响可归结为一个有效噪声项，据此可推导最优预训练策略；存在测试误差与表示质量不匹配的参数区间，并提出了主动微调的应用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高维统计理论分析，在极限高维下将预训练和微调两个阶段用有限个序参量进行渐近刻画，得到测试误差和表示对齐的显式预测。

papers.title: Coupled simulation of plasma-surface interactions during early stages of vacuum arcing
papers.abstract: We describe fully coupled simulations that bridge atomistic cathode dynamics and plasma formation during the earliest stages of vacuum arcing. The model combines molecular dynamics, finite element electrothermal calculations, electron emission and particle-in-cell plasma simulations via dynamic transfer of particles between the surface and plasma domains. Simulations of Cu nanoprotrusions reveal two routes to thermal runaway: direct Joule heating-driven instability and a novel nanoparticle-assisted mechanism, where detached nanoparticles generate neutral vapor that becomes ionized.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：fully coupled simulations、molecular dynamics、finite element、particle-in-cell plasma simulations）；研究对象：真空电弧早期阶段的等离子体-表面相互作用，具体以铜纳米突起（Cu nanoprotrusions）为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了两种导致热失控的路径：直接焦耳加热驱动的失稳，以及一种新型的纳米颗粒辅助机制——脱落的纳米颗粒产生中性蒸气，随后被电离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了两种导致热失控的路径：直接焦耳加热驱动的失稳，以及一种新型的纳米颗粒辅助机制——脱落的纳米颗粒产生中性蒸气，随后被电离。；创新点：首次实现了从原子尺度阴极动力学到等离子体形成的全耦合模拟，并发现了纳米颗粒辅助的热失控新机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用多物理场耦合模拟方法，包括分子动力学（MD）、有限元电热计算、电子发射模型以及粒子网格法（PIC）等离子体模拟，并通过表面与等离子体域之间的动态粒子传输实现耦合。

papers.title: Electrolyte Bonding Engineering for Highly Uniform GeTe-based CBRAM and Parallel Hebbian Learning in Selector-free Hopfield Networks
papers.abstract: Hopfield networks offer a hardware-friendly framework for energy-efficient associative memory, yet their practical realization in memristor crossbar arrays is critically hindered by device-to-device (D2D) variability, which prevents reliable parallel programming. Here, we address this bottleneck through systematic composition engineering of the Ge-Te solid electrolyte in conductive bridge random access memory (CBRAM) devices. By varying the Ge:Te ratio, we identify Ge3.5Te1 as an optimal electrolyte composition that suppresses stochastic resistance variation by approximately three orders of magnitude compared to GeSe-based devices. Raman spectroscopy reveals that this dramatic improvement originates from a bonding network dominated by asymmetric-stretching GeTe4 tetrahedral units, which form interconnected free-volume channels that confine and stabilize Cu+ ion migration pathways. Leveraging this enhanced uniformity, we fabricate a selector-less 16x16 Cu/Ge3.5Te1 CBRAM crossbar array and demonstrate a 4x4 Hopfield associative network capable of learning and recalling binary pattern pairs via fully parallel programming using a half-selection scheme. Successful pattern recall is achieved for up to two stored associations despite the absence of selector elements, establishing a proof-of-concept for selector-free hardware implementations of associative memory. These results highlight the critical role of electrolyte bonding structure in determining memristor uniformity and provide a materials-driven pathway toward scalable, parallel neuromorphic computing systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的材料制备（composition engineering）、器件表征（Raman spectroscopy）和阵列测试（fabricate a selector-less 16x16 crossbar array）。；研究对象：基于Ge-Te固体电解质的导电桥随机存取存储器（CBRAM）器件，以及由其构建的无选择器Hopfield神经网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将Ge-Te固体电解质的组分优化为Ge3.5Te1，可将CBRAM器件的阻变均匀性相较于GeSe基器件提升约三个数量级，并成功在无选择器的16x16交叉阵列中实现了4x4 Hopfield网络的并行学习和模式回忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将Ge-Te固体电解质的组分优化为Ge3.5Te1，可将CBRAM器件的阻变均匀性相较于GeSe基器件提升约三个数量级，并成功在无选择器的16x16交叉阵列中实现了4x4 Hopfield网络的并行学习和模式回忆。；创新点：揭示了电解质键合结构（由非对称伸缩GeTe4四面体单元主导）对CBRAM器件均匀性的决定性作用，并通过材料工程解决了器件间（D2D）变异性这一阻碍Hopfield网络并行编程的关键瓶颈，首次在无选择器交叉阵列中实现了基于CBRAM的Hopfield网络概念验证。
papers.method_zh: 组分工程（改变Ge:Te比例）、电学性能表征（阻变均匀性统计）、拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）分析键合网络结构、器件制备（Cu/Ge3.5Te1 CBRAM交叉阵列）、半选方案（half-selection scheme）实现并行编程。

papers.title: Detecting Topological Transitions and Anisotropy through Multipartite Entanglement in Holographic Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: We study multipartite entanglement structures in the zero-temperature holographic Weyl semimetal, focusing on tripartite and four-partite structures. For strip regions, we compute the conditional mutual information, the entanglement wedge cross section, tripartite measures $κ$ and the Markov gap, multi-EWCS, and two multi-EWCS based four-partite signals $Δ$ and $g$. These quantities are studied as functions of the strip width $l$ and the tuning parameter across the topological transition. At large $l$, their $l$ dependence takes a power-law form governed by the IR scaling of the system. At fixed large $l$, all these entanglement quantities develop clear features near the critical point, showing that tripartite and four-partite entanglement structures can diagnose the topological quantum phase transition. We further study strips pointing in different directions to probe the anisotropy of the system. The anisotropic large l behavior distinguishes the nontrivial phase from the trivial phase. These results establish multipartite holographic entanglement as a sensitive, nonlocal probe of topological phase transitions and anisotropic IR physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“holographic Weyl semimetal”（全息外尔半金属）、“compute”（计算）、“study”（研究）等关键词，属于全息对偶理论框架下的计算分析，未涉及实验或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：零温全息外尔半金属中的多体纠缠结构，特别是三体和四体纠缠，以及拓扑相变和体系各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多体纠缠量（如条件互信息、纠缠楔截面、三体度量κ、马尔可夫间隙、四体信号Δ和g）在拓扑相变临界点附近出现明显特征，表明多体纠缠结构可以诊断拓扑量子相变；各向异性的大尺度行为可区分非平庸相与平庸相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多体纠缠量（如条件互信息、纠缠楔截面、三体度量κ、马尔可夫间隙、四体信号Δ和g）在拓扑相变临界点附近出现明显特征，表明多体纠缠结构可以诊断拓扑量子相变；各向异性的大尺度行为可区分非平庸相与平庸相。；创新点：将多体纠缠（三体和四体）而非仅两体纠缠作为探针，用于诊断全息外尔半金属中的拓扑相变和各向异性红外物理。
papers.method_zh: 全息对偶（AdS/CFT对应）框架，通过计算条带区域的条件互信息、纠缠楔截面、三体度量κ、马尔可夫间隙、多体纠缠楔截面以及基于多体纠缠楔截面的四体信号Δ和g，分析这些量随条带宽度l和调控参数的变化，并研究不同方向条带以探测各向异性。

papers.title: HVPE Growth of Si-Doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ on Sapphire: Influence of Substrate Offcut on Structural and Electrical Properties
papers.abstract: Si-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ films were heteroepitaxially grown on sapphire substrates using HVPE. The influence of sapphire offcut on growth kinetics, surface morphology, crystalline quality, and electrical transport properties was systematically investigated. Growth kinetics studies revealed a strong dependence of deposition rate on HCl flow, growth pressure, and source-to-substrate distance, with growth rates reaching up to 30 $μ$m/hr. Increasing sapphire offcut angle from 0$^\circ$ to 8$^\circ$ promoted a transition from multidirectional growth to highly aligned terrace-dominated surfaces, reducing the surface roughness from 14.69 to 2.74 nm. The improved surface morphology was accompanied by enhanced crystalline quality, with phase-pure (-201)-oriented $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ growth and a reduction in the rocking-curve full width at half maximum from 994 to 414 arcsec as the sapphire offcut increased. Electrical characterization of films grown on 6$^\circ$ offcut substrates yielded carrier concentrations ranging from $1.0\times10^{17}$ to $3.4\times10^{18}$ cm$^{-3}$. A maximum room-temperature electron mobility of 100cm$^2$/V$\cdot$s was achieved at a carrier concentration of $1.0\times10^{17}$cm$^{-3}$, representing the highest reported room-temperature mobility for HVPE-grown $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ on a foreign substrate. Analysis of the temperature-dependent transport characteristics yielded donor activation energies of 35 and 90 meV together with a low acceptor concentration of $3\times10^{15}$ cm$^{-3}$, consistent with the improved crystalline quality achieved on the offcut sapphire substrates. These results demonstrate that HVPE is capable of producing high-quality $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ heteroepitaxial layers with good crystalline quality and carrier transport characteristics, providing a promising pathway for scalable $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ epitaxy on low-cost foreign substrates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：HVPE生长、实验表征、电学测量。；研究对象：Si掺杂β-Ga₂O₃薄膜在蓝宝石衬底上的异质外延生长，重点研究衬底偏切角对结构及电学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过增大蓝宝石衬底偏切角（从0°到8°），实现了表面形貌从多方向生长向高度有序台阶主导表面的转变，表面粗糙度从14.69 nm降至2.74 nm，晶体质量显著提升（摇摆曲线半高宽从994 arcsec降至414 arcsec）。在6°偏切角衬底上生长的薄膜获得了最高室温电子迁移率100 cm²/V·s（载流子浓度1.0×10¹⁷ cm⁻³），这是HVPE法在异质衬底上生长β-Ga₂O₃的最高报道值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过增大蓝宝石衬底偏切角（从0°到8°），实现了表面形貌从多方向生长向高度有序台阶主导表面的转变，表面粗糙度从14.69 nm降至2.74 nm，晶体质量显著提升（摇摆曲线半高宽从994 arcsec降至414 arcsec）。在6°偏切角衬底上生长的薄膜获得了最高室温电子迁移率100 cm²/V·s（载流子浓度1.0×10¹⁷ cm⁻³），这是HVPE法在异质衬底上生长β-Ga₂O₃的最高报道值。；创新点：系统揭示了蓝宝石衬底偏切角对HVPE生长β-Ga₂O₃的动力学、形貌、晶体质量及电学性能的综合影响，并在异质衬底上实现了创纪录的室温电子迁移率。
papers.method_zh: 采用氢化物气相外延（HVPE）技术生长Si掺杂β-Ga₂O₃薄膜；使用X射线衍射（摇摆曲线）评估晶体质量；通过电学输运测量（变温霍尔效应）获得载流子浓度、迁移率及施主/受主激活能。

papers.title: Thermalization with Gaussian Quantum Cellular Automata
papers.abstract: We study the long-time dynamics of many-body bosonic lattice systems under translation-invariant Gaussian quantum cellular automata. We formulate two sets of conditions on GQCAs which separately guarantee thermalization of any state on the local Weyl algebra to the infinite temperature state, whenever the state is locally normal and has uniformly bounded particle density. Our main intermediate result is a quantum many-body generalization of the classic Riemann-Lebesgue lemma which is a bound on expectation values of local Weyl operators involving their support and the state's particle density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Gaussian quantum cellular automata、thermalization、quantum many-body generalization。；研究对象：多体玻色子晶格系统在平移不变高斯量子元胞自动机（GQCA）作用下的长时间动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出了两组条件，分别保证在局部正常且粒子密度一致有界的情况下，任何局部Weyl代数上的态都会热化到无穷温度态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出了两组条件，分别保证在局部正常且粒子密度一致有界的情况下，任何局部Weyl代数上的态都会热化到无穷温度态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：对高斯量子元胞自动机（GQCA）施加两组条件，并证明了一个量子多体版本的经典Riemann-Lebesgue引理，该引理给出了局部Weyl算符期望值的上界，涉及算符支撑和态的粒子密度。

papers.title: Methods for Inferring Interaction Potentials from Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry Data
papers.abstract: Cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) has emerged as a powerful quantitative technique for probing intra-protein structural information as well as protein-protein interactions at an unprecedented scale. XL-MS data yield information on the pairwise spatial proximity of proteins through inter-molecular linkers. However, systematic methods for adapting such data for coarse-grained interacting particle models remain limited. Predominant focus is put on directly fitting radial distribution functions (RDFs), while numerous observables, e.g. coordination numbers, which are functionals of the RDF, cannot be uniquely inverted. In this work, we develop a framework for parameterizing interaction potentials from such observables in potentially phase-separated mixtures, as encountered in XL-MS results. We establish a connection between this problem and the inverse Henderson problem and adapt algorithms such as Iterative Boltzmann Inversion and Iterative Monte Carlo to its numerical solution. We derive exact and low-density limit gradient approximations and propose two new algorithms based on an adaptation of the predictor-corrector~framework. In total, we evaluate several optimization algorithms on biologically realistic ten-component test systems. We demonstrate that for homogeneous fluids, all methods achieve exceptional efficiency and accuracy. Critically, we further demonstrate successful parametrization in a challenging three-phase system. Here, three algorithms, namely Adam and gradient descent employing the low-density derivative as well as Newton's method with the exact gradient, reliably recover the correct parameters. These results establish a clear pathway from XL-MS experiments to coarse-grained protein models for systems where phase separation governs biological function, potentially enabling new investigations of biomolecular condensates and protein aggregation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：develop a framework、adapt algorithms、Iterative Boltzmann Inversion、Iterative Monte Carlo、numerical solution。；研究对象：从交联质谱（XL-MS）数据中推断粗粒化相互作用势的方法，应用于可能发生相分离的蛋白质混合物体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在均匀流体中，所有优化算法均表现出极高的效率和准确性；在挑战性的三相系统中，Adam、使用低密度导数的梯度下降以及使用精确梯度的牛顿法三种算法能可靠地恢复正确参数，从而建立了从XL-MS实验到粗粒化蛋白质模型的清晰路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在均匀流体中，所有优化算法均表现出极高的效率和准确性；在挑战性的三相系统中，Adam、使用低密度导数的梯度下降以及使用精确梯度的牛顿法三种算法能可靠地恢复正确参数，从而建立了从XL-MS实验到粗粒化蛋白质模型的清晰路径。；创新点：针对XL-MS数据中除径向分布函数（RDF）外的其他可观测量（如配位数）无法唯一反演的问题，开发了从这些可观测量参数化相互作用势的系统框架，并成功应用于相分离混合物体系。
papers.method_zh: 将问题与逆Henderson问题建立联系，采用迭代玻尔兹曼反演（Iterative Boltzmann Inversion）和迭代蒙特卡洛（Iterative Monte Carlo）等算法进行数值求解；推导了精确梯度和低密度极限梯度近似；提出了两种基于预测-校正框架的新算法；在生物真实的十组分测试系统上评估了多种优化算法（包括Adam、梯度下降、牛顿法）。

papers.title: Newton's Identity in Finite-Bead Fermionic Partition Function
papers.abstract: For non-interacting fermions in a harmonic trap, the partition function at any discrete number of imaginary time slices (or beads) and for any choice of short-time propagator admits an exact recursion relation derived directly from the contracted determinant form of the path integral. This finite-bead recursion is distinct from earlier continuum-limit recursions, which do not apply to the discrete time partition functions. By identifying a direct correspondence between this recursion and Newton's identity, application of a closed-form result from the theory of partitions provides an exact expression for the one-dimensional $n$-fermion finite-bead partition function. From this, the Thermodynamic and Hamiltonian energies and specific heats are analytically calculated for any $n$, $N$, $τ$, and propagator choice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：exact recursion relation（精确递归关系）、closed-form result（闭式解）、analytically calculated（解析计算）。；研究对象：一维简谐势阱中无相互作用费米子的有限虚时间切片（有限珠子）配分函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现有限珠子费米子配分函数满足的递归关系与牛顿恒等式之间存在直接对应，从而利用分拆理论的闭式结果，得到了任意费米子数、任意时间切片数和任意短时传播子选择下的配分函数精确表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现有限珠子费米子配分函数满足的递归关系与牛顿恒等式之间存在直接对应，从而利用分拆理论的闭式结果，得到了任意费米子数、任意时间切片数和任意短时传播子选择下的配分函数精确表达式。；创新点：该有限珠子递归关系不同于此前仅适用于连续极限的递归关系，首次将离散时间路径积分下的配分函数与牛顿恒等式及分拆理论建立直接联系，从而获得任意参数下的精确解析表达式。
papers.method_zh: 从路径积分的收缩行列式形式出发，推导出有限珠子配分函数的精确递归关系；通过识别该递归与牛顿恒等式的对应，应用分拆理论的闭式结果进行解析求解；最终解析计算了热力学能量、哈密顿量能量和比热容。

papers.title: The MuFusE Large-Volume Diamond Anvil Cell for Exploring Muon-Catalyzed Fusion at Higher Pressures and Temperatures
papers.abstract: A new large-volume diamond anvil cell (DAC) has been developed for the Muon-catalyzed Fusion ($μ$CF) Experiment (MuFusE), enabling the compression and heating of deuterium-tritium (d-t) mixtures to pressures and temperatures needed to advance $μ$CF research. The MuFusE DAC achieves the large sample volumes necessary for high-precision fusion measurements while integrating cryogenic loading, all-metal sealing, and flexible bellows to maintain a secure environment during cell compression. Combined with remote pneumatic actuation and secondary containment, the DAC safely managed a 25 Ci tritium inventory while providing a clear optical path for in situ measurements of sample pressure and composition via laser spectroscopy. Utilizing 5 mm diameter diamond anvils oriented in the path of a high-intensity muon beam, the apparatus achieved a stable sample volume of 19.2 mm$^3$ at liquid density, pressures up to 933 MPa and temperatures up to 400 K - benchmarks that significantly exceed previously reported limits for static d-t targets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了新装置（large-volume diamond anvil cell）的开发、具体实验参数（压力、温度、样品体积）及安全设计（氚管理、光学路径等）。；研究对象：μ子催化聚变（Muon-catalyzed Fusion, μCF）中的氘-氚（d-t）混合物，在高压高温条件下的静态压缩与加热。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 新开发的大体积金刚石对顶砧（DAC）实现了对氘-氚混合物的静态压缩至933 MPa和400 K，样品体积达19.2 mm³，显著超过了此前静态d-t靶标的报道极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：新开发的大体积金刚石对顶砧（DAC）实现了对氘-氚混合物的静态压缩至933 MPa和400 K，样品体积达19.2 mm³，显著超过了此前静态d-t靶标的报道极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验装置开发：大体积金刚石对顶砧（DAC），结合低温装载、全金属密封、柔性波纹管、远程气动驱动、二次安全容器，以及通过激光光谱进行原位压力和成分测量。

papers.title: Krylov Complexity: Flat bands and Carroll breaking deformations
papers.abstract: Systems with flat band structures, when written in the language of Compact Localised States (CLS), have been shown to be explicitly invariant under supertranslation symmetries, making Carrollian symmetries inherently important for such systems. In this work, we explore the state dynamics of these systems, focusing on quenches induced by Carroll breaking perturbations, through the probe of Krylov (spread) Complexity. We specialise to Fermionic ladder Hamiltonians with all bands flat (ABF) scenario, augmented by a supertranslation preserving interaction, and discuss Krylov state complexity for quenches across critical lines. We further discuss how the growth of Krylov complexity sharply resolves the phase-dependent resilience of Carrollian sectors against delocalising perturbations. This is augmented by a complementary mechanism for Krylov growth in a continuum Carroll scalar field theory with a gradient deformation, which exhibits strong ultraviolet sensitivity (UV/IR mixing).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“we explore”“we discuss”“we specialise to”等理论推导与模型分析用语，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：具有平带结构的费米子梯子哈密顿量系统，以及连续Carroll标量场理论。具体关注平带系统在Carroll对称性破缺扰动下的态动力学与Krylov复杂度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Krylov（扩展）复杂度探针，发现平带系统在Carroll对称性破缺淬火下，复杂度增长能够清晰分辨Carroll扇区对退局域化扰动的相位依赖性；同时，连续Carroll标量场理论中的梯度变形会导致强烈的紫外敏感性（UV/IR混合），并驱动Krylov复杂度增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Krylov（扩展）复杂度探针，发现平带系统在Carroll对称性破缺淬火下，复杂度增长能够清晰分辨Carroll扇区对退局域化扰动的相位依赖性；同时，连续Carroll标量场理论中的梯度变形会导致强烈的紫外敏感性（UV/IR混合），并驱动Krylov复杂度增长。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：使用Krylov复杂度（spread complexity）作为动力学探针；模型构建：采用所有能带均为平带（ABF）的费米子梯子哈密顿量，并加入超平移保持的相互作用；分析手段：研究跨越临界线的淬火动力学，以及连续Carroll标量场理论中梯度变形下的复杂度演化。

papers.title: Isospectrality and Operator Complexity
papers.abstract: We study a pair of exactly solvable, isospectral fermion chains, one strongly interacting and one quadratic, that nevertheless display remarkably different phase structures and operator dynamics. A nonlocal nonlinear unitary transformation maps one onto the other while preserving the entire many-body spectrum and converting local fermion operators into extended many-body strings. Thus, operators that evolve within a closed linear subspace in the quadratic model become interacting operators that generate increasingly higher-body terms and exhibit asymptotic Lanczos growth $b_n\propto\sqrt n$. Despite their identical spectra, the two models realize distinct phases and sharply different notions of operator complexity. Our results demonstrate that free many-body spectra and interacting operator dynamics are fundamentally compatible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly solvable（精确可解）、unitary transformation（幺正变换）、Lanczos growth（Lanczos增长）。；研究对象：一对等谱费米子链，其中一个为强相互作用模型，另一个为二次型（无相互作用）模型，研究其相结构与算符复杂度的差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管两个模型具有完全相同的多体能谱，但它们展现出截然不同的相结构和算符动力学：二次型模型中的局域算符在封闭线性子空间内演化，而强相互作用模型中的算符会生成高阶多体项，并表现出渐近的Lanczos增长（b_n ∝ √n），表明自由谱与相互作用算符动力学可以共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管两个模型具有完全相同的多体能谱，但它们展现出截然不同的相结构和算符动力学：二次型模型中的局域算符在封闭线性子空间内演化，而强相互作用模型中的算符会生成高阶多体项，并表现出渐近的Lanczos增长（b_n ∝ √n），表明自由谱与相互作用算符动力学可以共存。；创新点：首次在等谱条件下系统展示了自由多体谱与相互作用算符动力学之间的兼容性，揭示了算符复杂度与能谱结构之间的解耦关系。
papers.method_zh: 通过非局域非线性幺正变换将一个模型映射到另一个，保持整个多体谱不变，同时将局域费米子算符转化为扩展的多体弦算符；利用Lanczos系数分析算符复杂度。

papers.title: Emergent Self-Similar Quantum Revivals in Spiral Drives
papers.abstract: We uncover a distinct form of nonequilibrium temporal order: self-similar quantum revivals in a many-body system driven by quasiperiodic spiral kicks, where the system recurrently returns close to its initial state at a hierarchically nested sequence of times. We demonstrate that both the fidelity and entanglement entropy exhibit this self-similar temporal structure. It originates from an emergent dynamical attractor, which we identify, such that all momentum modes eventually fall into the same closed orbits at self-similar times. We analytically justify this behavior and show that, for special momentum modes, this attractor arises as a consequence of a generalized spin echo process, and more generally we prove its existence using quasiperiodic SU(2) cocycles. Interestingly, the dynamics between consecutive revivals supports either volume- or area-law entanglement scaling, tunable via the driving parameters. In the presence of integrability-breaking perturbations, the system eventually heats up, but a long-lived prethermal regime with algebraically tunable lifetime occurs before heating sets in. Our results establish self-similar quantum revivals as a new paradigm for nonequilibrium quantum matter and provide a realistic route for its observation in current quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：uncover、demonstrate、analytically justify、prove、quasiperiodic SU(2) cocycles。；研究对象：受准周期螺旋脉冲驱动的多体量子系统中的非平衡时间序，具体为自相似量子复兴现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准周期螺旋脉冲驱动的多体系统中，系统会在一个层级嵌套的时间序列上反复回到接近初始状态，形成自相似的时间结构；该现象源于一个涌现的动力学吸引子，使得所有动量模式在自相似时刻落入相同的闭合轨道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准周期螺旋脉冲驱动的多体系统中，系统会在一个层级嵌套的时间序列上反复回到接近初始状态，形成自相似的时间结构；该现象源于一个涌现的动力学吸引子，使得所有动量模式在自相似时刻落入相同的闭合轨道。；创新点：发现了自相似量子复兴作为一种全新的非平衡时间序范式，并揭示了其背后的动力学吸引子机制；展示了在连续复兴之间纠缠熵可被驱动参数调控为体积律或面积律；预言了在可积性破缺下具有代数可调寿命的预热化阶段。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用准周期SU(2)余循环（quasiperiodic SU(2) cocycles）证明吸引子的存在；通过广义自旋回波过程解释特殊动量模式的行为；通过保真度和纠缠熵表征时间结构；通过驱动参数调控纠缠标度律（体积律/面积律）；引入可积性破缺微扰研究预热化行为。

papers.title: Hypergroup Symmetry in Relative Quantum Field Theories and Chiral Algebras
papers.abstract: A QFT is said to be relative if it lives at the boundary of a topological QFT in one higher dimension. We develop a general framework for working with noninvertible symmetries of relative theories in two spacetime dimensions, extending several well-known results for absolute QFTs. We emphasize various new features which arise in the relative setting, including the role of topological surfaces of the bulk, and the appearance of hypergroups and certain generalizations of tube algebras known as dome algebras. Our formalism is particularly well-suited for studying rational chiral algebras, where it predicts that finite symmetries are in explicit one-to-one correspondence with conformal embeddings of finite index. We describe several implications of our framework for absolute theories. First, we explain how to "glue" together symmetries of the left- and right-moving chiral algebras of a 2D CFT to produce topological line defects of the full theory. Second, we derive a precise correspondence between boundary conditions of a 2D CFT and symmetries of its chiral algebra. This correspondence has several structural corollaries: in diagonal rational CFTs, we demonstrate that the topological line defects of the theory act transitively on its boundary conditions, and further that the identity Cardy state has the smallest $g$-function amongst all boundary conditions, including those which only preserve Virasoro symmetry. We conclude by illustrating our results in a variety of examples. For instance, we show that, if there exists a rational chiral algebra with central charge $c=8$ whose modular tensor category is the Drinfeld center of the Haagerup fusion category, then it must arise as the fixed points of a rank-2 hypergroup acting on the $SU(3)_1\otimes (E_{6})_1$ chiral algebra.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：relative QFT、topological QFT、hypergroup symmetry、chiral algebras。；研究对象：二维时空中的相对量子场论（relative QFT）及其非可逆对称性，特别聚焦于有理手征代数（rational chiral algebras）和二维共形场论（2D CFT）中的边界条件与拓扑线缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了相对QFT中有限对称性与有限指标共形嵌入之间的一一对应关系；证明了在有理对角CFT中，拓扑线缺陷可传递地作用于边界条件，且恒等Cardy态在所有边界条件（包括仅保留Virasoro对称性的边界条件）中具有最小的g-函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了相对QFT中有限对称性与有限指标共形嵌入之间的一一对应关系；证明了在有理对角CFT中，拓扑线缺陷可传递地作用于边界条件，且恒等Cardy态在所有边界条件（包括仅保留Virasoro对称性的边界条件）中具有最小的g-函数。；创新点：将非可逆对称性研究从绝对QFT系统性地扩展到相对QFT，揭示了体拓扑曲面在相对设置中的新角色，并首次将超群与穹代数应用于手征代数对称性的分类。摘要未突出说明与已有绝对QFT对称性框架的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 利用体拓扑QFT的拓扑曲面结构，引入超群（hypergroup）和管代数推广的“穹代数”（dome algebras）作为理论框架，并结合手征代数的共形嵌入与模张量范畴（如Haagerup融合范畴的Drinfeld中心）进行分析。

papers.title: Frustrated superradiant phases in one- and two-dimensional lattices
papers.abstract: Understanding how frustration and symmetry breaking shape collective behavior is a central problem in quantum many-body systems. In this work, we investigate this problem in large one- and two-dimensional arrays of coupled Dicke models on a periodic lattice, where strong light-matter coupling gives rise to a superradiant phase and competition between neighboring order parameters induces spontaneous translational symmetry breaking. Such Dicke lattice models constitute a fundamentally new class of quantum many-body systems, as they simultaneously realize the thermodynamic limit associated with the lattice size and an intrinsic thermodynamic limit arising from collective on-site interactions with quantum emitters. We show that frustration drives photonic density-wave ordering, and that the resulting broken periodicity can be predicted from the excitation spectrum of the symmetric phase, without requiring computationally prohibitive thermodynamic energy minimization. Furthermore, we demonstrate that an emergent Nambu-Goldstone mode arises near the critical point in a one-dimensional chain despite the presence of only discrete symmetry, and uncover the mechanism that enables this otherwise forbidden gapless excitation. We also find quasi-periodic ordering in the superradiant phase, reminiscent of quasicrystals, and demonstrate that synthetic magnetic flux provides a powerful knob to control the nature of translational symmetry breaking. Our results establish a new direction in quantum many-body physics where the coexistence of local and global thermodynamic limits gives rise to unconventional symmetry breaking and emergent collective behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate this problem in large one- and two-dimensional arrays of coupled Dicke models on a periodic lattice”，并基于模型进行理论分析，未涉及实验或具体计算模拟方法。；研究对象：一维和二维周期性晶格上耦合Dicke模型阵列中的超辐射相，以及由竞争序参量导致的自发平移对称性破缺和光子密度波有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现阻挫驱动光子密度波有序，且对称相激发谱可预测破缺周期性；在一维链中临界点附近出现原本被禁戒的Nambu-Goldstone模，并揭示了其产生机制；超辐射相中还存在类似准晶的准周期有序，且合成磁通可调控平移对称性破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现阻挫驱动光子密度波有序，且对称相激发谱可预测破缺周期性；在一维链中临界点附近出现原本被禁戒的Nambu-Goldstone模，并揭示了其产生机制；超辐射相中还存在类似准晶的准周期有序，且合成磁通可调控平移对称性破缺。；创新点：首次在同时具有晶格尺寸热力学极限和局域集体相互作用热力学极限的Dicke晶格模型中，系统研究阻挫驱动的平移对称性破缺，并发现准周期有序及合成磁通调控的新机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于耦合Dicke模型在周期性晶格上的集体光-物质相互作用，利用对称相激发谱预测破缺周期性，并分析Nambu-Goldstone模的涌现机制。

papers.title: GEMINI: Generalized Ensnarlment Measure from Incomplete-linkage of Network-network Interactions
papers.abstract: Spatially embedded networks are central to many physical and biological systems, where geometry and connectivity jointly shape structure and function. Examples abound across the scales of biological organization, from network-like membrane-bound organelles in the cell to mesoscale tissue organization of multiple distinct flow networks in organs and beyond. In each of these cases, the complexity of the architectures has heretofore frustrated our ability to link mechanism or regulation of these structures to reduced modeling or even relevant characterization, putting structure-function relationships largely out of reach.
