Spin-triplet components are highly beneficial for superspintronic devices. Whether ASOC alone $-$ without strong electronic correlations $-$ is sufficient to generate a measurable triplet component remains a central open question. Here, we resolve this question in Nb$_{18}$Re$_{82}$ (Nb-Re), a weakly-correlated noncentrosymmetric metal whose superconducting pairing symmetry has been actively debated. Using low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy on single crystals with four distinct crystallographic orientations, find a pronounced orientation-dependent anisotropy in the local density of states. Supported by a symmetry-constrained model, we show that the complete set of tunneling spectra requires a mixed-parity order parameter with the triplet amplitude reaching up to half of the singlet component. These results reconcile the conflicting reports in the literature on Nb-Re and demonstrate that ASOC is sufficient to foster a sizable spin-triplet component even without strong electronic correlations, suggesting that mixed-parity superconducting states may be more widespread than previously assumed. Since Nb-Re can be readily fabricated in thin-film form, these findings position it as an accessible platform for superspintronic devices and establish orientation-resolved tunneling spectroscopy as a general protocol for the detection of mixed-parity order parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunneling spectroscopy、single crystals、orientation-dependent anisotropy）；研究对象：非中心对称弱关联金属 Nb₁₈Re₈₂（Nb-Re）的超导配对对称性，特别是其混合宇称序参量中的自旋三重态分量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱关联非中心对称金属 Nb-Re 中，仅凭反对称自旋轨道耦合（ASOC）即可产生可观测的自旋三重态分量，其振幅可达单重态分量的一半，从而解决了该材料超导配对对称性的争议。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱关联非中心对称金属 Nb-Re 中，仅凭反对称自旋轨道耦合（ASOC）即可产生可观测的自旋三重态分量，其振幅可达单重态分量的一半，从而解决了该材料超导配对对称性的争议。；创新点：首次通过取向分辨的隧道谱实验证明，在无强电子关联的情况下，仅靠 ASOC 即可产生显著的自旋三重态分量，并建立了取向分辨隧道谱作为检测混合宇称序参量的通用方法。
papers.method_zh: 使用低温扫描隧道谱（STM/STS）测量四种不同晶面取向的单晶样品，结合对称性约束模型分析局域态密度的取向依赖性各向异性。

papers.title: Local multiferroic ordering at room temperature in collinear magnetoelectric antiferromagnets induced by flexo-Zeeman coupling
papers.abstract: Spin-driven multiferroicity attracts significant interest due to its tunability and inherently strong magnetoelectric coupling. While this mechanism induces sizeable electric polarization, it typically occurs at low temperatures and in complex materials. In the simple oxide, the magnetoelectric antiferromagnet Cr$_2$O$_3$, we experimentally demonstrate the existence of specific domain walls that act as room-temperature multiferroic regions. This behavior stems from an anisotropic crystal-symmetry-dependent mechanism of exchange origin, which is applicable to a broad class of bipartite antiferromagnets. The key signature is the magnetization occurring at antiferromagnetic textures, driven by the flexo-Zeeman interaction. These findings establish a foundation for exploring high-temperature spin-driven multiferroicity for magnetoelectric spin-orbit memory and logic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we experimentally demonstrate”（我们实验证明了）以及“key signature is the magnetization occurring at antiferromagnetic textures”（关键特征是反铁磁织构中出现的磁化）。；研究对象：磁电反铁磁体Cr₂O₃中的特定畴壁，以及由flexo-Zeeman耦合诱导的室温局域多铁有序现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在简单氧化物Cr₂O₃中，存在特定畴壁，这些畴壁可作为室温多铁区域，其行为源于各向异性晶体对称性依赖的交换起源机制，适用于一大类二分反铁磁体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在简单氧化物Cr₂O₃中，存在特定畴壁，这些畴壁可作为室温多铁区域，其行为源于各向异性晶体对称性依赖的交换起源机制，适用于一大类二分反铁磁体。；创新点：首次在简单氧化物中实验证明室温下存在自旋驱动的多铁性区域，且该机制不依赖复杂材料或低温条件，为高温自旋驱动多铁性在磁电自旋轨道存储和逻辑应用中的探索奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：在磁电反铁磁体Cr₂O₃中进行实验观测。理论框架：基于flexo-Zeeman相互作用（反铁磁织构中由弯曲应变驱动的塞曼效应）以及晶体对称性依赖的交换起源机制。

papers.title: Curvature-driven revival of charge density waves in non-Euclidean space
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated quantum states, such as charge density waves (CDWs), are exquisitely sensitive to Fermi surface topology and lattice symmetry, and are typically quenched by heavy carrier doping. In two-dimensional (2D) systems, however, macroscopic geometric curvature emerges as a novel structural degree of freedom to modulate microscopic quantum coherence. This raises a compelling physical question: can non-Euclidean geometric deformations compete with extreme electronic perturbations to reshape, or even revive, a quenched macroscopic quantum order? Here, by constructing monolayer TiSe$_2$-NbSe$_2$ heterostructure on a BLG/SiC substrate for the first time, we report the curvature-driven revival of a frustrated charge order in a non-Euclidean space. Low-temperature angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) reveals a massive interfacial charge transfer, which destroys the global Fermi surface nesting and completely suppresses the long-range CDW order in Euclidean flat regions. Strikingly, high-resolution scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) reveals that a novel, non-linear CDW state miraculously survives, remaining strictly localized within morphologically distorted, non-Euclidean nanoscale curved regions. Atomistic simulations unravel the structural origin of this phenomenon, demonstrating that interfacial twist and lattice mismatch spontaneously generate a corrugated superlattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：ARPES、STM、异质结构建、原子模拟）；研究对象：单层TiSe₂-NbSe₂异质结生长在BLG/SiC衬底上，研究非欧几里得空间（纳米尺度弯曲区域）中电荷密度波（CDW）的复兴现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在欧几里得平坦区域，界面电荷转移破坏了费米面嵌套并完全抑制了长程CDW序；但在非欧几里得纳米弯曲区域，一种新型非线性CDW态奇迹般地存活并严格局域化，实现了曲率驱动的淬灭电荷序复兴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在欧几里得平坦区域，界面电荷转移破坏了费米面嵌套并完全抑制了长程CDW序；但在非欧几里得纳米弯曲区域，一种新型非线性CDW态奇迹般地存活并严格局域化，实现了曲率驱动的淬灭电荷序复兴。；创新点：首次在非欧几里得空间中通过宏观几何曲率调控微观量子相干，实现了对已被载流子掺杂淬灭的CDW序的复兴，揭示了曲率与强关联电子态竞争的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 低温角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）探测界面电荷转移和能带结构；高分辨扫描隧道显微镜（STM）观测局域CDW态；原子模拟（atomistic simulations）揭示界面扭转和晶格失配自发产生波纹超晶格的结构起源。

papers.title: Local-to-global heating crossover in chains of nanomagnets: A two-scale analytical framework
papers.abstract: We develop a two-scale analytical formalism to study heat generation and thermal transport in one-dimensional systems of nanomagnets subjected to a uniform alternating magnetic field. At the nanoscale, each nanomagnet acts as a localized, temperature-dependent heat source governed by its magnetic response, dipolar interactions, and interfacial coupling to the matrix, characterized by a nanoscale volumetric loss coefficient $L_m$. After spatial and temporal averaging, we obtain a coarse-grained assembly-scale equation with effective heating terms and a macroscopic loss coefficient $L_N$. Using modal decomposition, we solve both equations exactly under Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions and establish explicit conditions for a local-to-global heating crossover; this is governed by the competition between heat generation, diffusion, dipolar coupling, and hierarchical losses. The crossover is quantified through the spatial correlation length and temperature variance, with stability criteria incorporating both diffusion and nanoscale losses. The coarse-graining procedure is derived rigorously, and its systematic approximation errors are quantified. For prototypical magnetic hyperthermia systems, such as magnetite nanomagnets in water, our formalism reveals that realistic parameters place these systems firmly in the collective heating regime, with local temperature variations at the $\simμ$K level, which is currently unresolvable experimentally. The continuum Fourier description used here is validated by a Knudsen-number analysis ($\mathrm{Kn} \ll 1$ for amorphous polymer and aqueous matrices).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a two-scale analytical formalism（发展双尺度解析形式）、coarse-graining procedure（粗粒化过程）、modal decomposition（模态分解）。；研究对象：一维纳米磁体链在均匀交变磁场中的热产生与热输运现象，具体以磁铁矿纳米磁体在水中的磁热疗系统为原型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现并量化了纳米磁体链中从局域加热到全局加热的交叉行为，该交叉由热产生、扩散、偶极相互作用和多层级损耗之间的竞争决定。对于典型的磁热疗系统，实际参数使系统处于集体加热区，局域温度变化仅在微开尔文量级，目前实验无法分辨。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现并量化了纳米磁体链中从局域加热到全局加热的交叉行为，该交叉由热产生、扩散、偶极相互作用和多层级损耗之间的竞争决定。对于典型的磁热疗系统，实际参数使系统处于集体加热区，局域温度变化仅在微开尔文量级，目前实验无法分辨。；创新点：建立了一个从纳米尺度到宏观组装尺度的严格解析框架，首次明确给出了局域-全局加热交叉的解析条件，并系统量化了粗粒化过程的近似误差。摘要未突出说明与已有唯象模型或数值模拟相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个双尺度解析理论框架：在纳米尺度，每个纳米磁体被视为由磁响应、偶极相互作用和界面耦合决定的局域热源，由纳米尺度体积损耗系数 \(L_m\) 表征；在组装尺度，通过空间和时间平均得到粗粒化方程，包含有效加热项和宏观损耗系数 \(L_N\)。利用模态分解在狄利克雷和诺伊曼边界条件下精确求解两个尺度的方程，并通过空间关联长度和温度方差量化交叉行为。最后通过克努森数分析（Kn << 1）验证了连续傅里叶描述的适用性。

papers.title: Finite-Basis Duality Estimate for the Surface-Code Threshold under Correlated Bit-Flip Errors
papers.abstract: We apply finite-basis duality to a statistical-mechanical model introduced by Chubb and Flammia for the surface code under spatially correlated bit-flip noise. Their mapping gives a random-bond Ising model with both two-body edge interactions and four-body face interactions. The single-equation estimate based on the duality analysis is slightly deviated from their Monte Carlo estimate \(p_c=0.1004(6)\). Following the finite-basis and graph-polynomial strategy, we instead use periodic and twisted-periodic sectors on toroidal bases. We have obtained an improved estimate of the critical point, $p_c = 0.10348$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：finite-basis duality、graph-polynomial strategy、duality analysis。；研究对象：表面码（surface code）在空间关联比特翻转噪声（spatially correlated bit-flip noise）下的容错阈值。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过有限基对偶和图多项式策略，在环面基底的周期和扭曲周期扇区上计算，得到了改进的表面码临界点估计值 \(p_c = 0.10348\)，优于此前基于单一方程对偶分析得到的估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过有限基对偶和图多项式策略，在环面基底的周期和扭曲周期扇区上计算，得到了改进的表面码临界点估计值 \(p_c = 0.10348\)，优于此前基于单一方程对偶分析得到的估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 有限基对偶（finite-basis duality）与图多项式（graph-polynomial）策略，结合环面基底上的周期和扭曲周期扇区分析。

papers.title: Tunable Rashba Splitting in Janus InXPbP (X = S, Se, Te) Monolayers for Enhanced Photocatalytic Water Splitting
papers.abstract: Janus two-dimensional (2D) materials exhibiting Rashba spin splitting have recently attracted considerable attention owing to their potential applications in spintronic devices and photocatalytic water splitting. In this work, we investigate, using first-principles calculations, the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, and photocatalytic properties of Janus InXPbP (X = S, Se, Te) monolayers that exhibit significant Rashba effects. Our results demonstrate that all three monolayers are energetically, dynamically, and mechanically stable, as evidenced by cohesive energy calculations, phonon dispersion analysis, and elastic constants. By varying the chalcogen atom (X = S, Se, Te), the Rashba effect in InXPbP can be effectively tuned. Rashba parameters of 0.16 and 0.20 eVÅ are obtained near the conduction-band minimum (CBM) for InSPbP and InSePbP, respectively, whereas InTePbP exhibits giant Rashba spin splitting near both the CBM and valence-band maximum (VBM), with corresponding Rashba parameters of 0.90 and 0.87 eVÅ. Furthermore, the Janus InXPbP monolayers exhibit suitable band gaps of 1.21, 1.27, and 0.76 eV for InSPbP, InSePbP, and InTePbP, respectively, which are favorable for photocatalytic applications. All three monolayers possess suitable band-edge alignments for overall water splitting, yielding solar-to-hydrogen (STH) conversion efficiencies of 21.67%, 26.03%, and 29.83% for InSPbP, InSePbP, and InTePbP, respectively. Our findings not only enrich the family of Janus materials but also suggest that the Janus InXPbP monolayers are promising candidates for spintronic devices and high-performance photocatalytic water-splitting applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：Janus InXPbP (X = S, Se, Te) 单层材料，具体研究其结构、力学、电子、光学和光催化性质，以及其中的Rashba自旋劈裂效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Janus InXPbP单层材料表现出可调的Rashba自旋劈裂效应，其中InTePbP在导带底和价带顶附近均具有巨大的Rashba劈裂（参数分别为0.90和0.87 eVÅ）；同时，三种材料均具有适合全解水的带边位置，太阳能到氢能转换效率最高可达29.83%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Janus InXPbP单层材料表现出可调的Rashba自旋劈裂效应，其中InTePbP在导带底和价带顶附近均具有巨大的Rashba劈裂（参数分别为0.90和0.87 eVÅ）；同时，三种材料均具有适合全解水的带边位置，太阳能到氢能转换效率最高可达29.83%。；创新点：首次系统研究了Janus InXPbP单层家族中通过改变硫族元素（S、Se、Te）来调控Rashba自旋劈裂，并发现InTePbP具有巨大的Rashba效应（0.90 eVÅ），同时兼具优异的光催化全解水性能。摘要未突出说明与已有Janus材料相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括：结合能计算（验证能量稳定性）、声子色散分析（验证动力学稳定性）、弹性常数计算（验证力学稳定性），以及能带结构、光学性质和光催化性能分析。

papers.title: Why Fe doping kills photoluminescence in CsPbCl$_3$ but not in CsPbBr$_3$: Role of midgap Fe 3$d$ states and electron-phonon coupling
papers.abstract: Understanding the impact of transition-metal doping on the optoelectronic properties of halide perovskite nanocrystals is essential for their rational design in photonic applications. We establish the microscopic origin of photoluminescence (PL) quenching in Fe-doped CsPbCl$_3$ using spin-polarized density functional theory calculations. The emergence of Fe 3$d$ midgap states creates efficient electron-trapping centres that drive nonradiative recombination, accounting for the reduced PL intensity. Extending this analysis to Fe-doped CsPbX$_3$ (X = Cl, Br), we show experimentally that although PL intensity is suppressed in both systems relative to their pristine counterparts, their high-doping behaviour diverges: CsPbCl$_3$ becomes completely non-emissive, whereas CsPbBr$_3$ retains a finite, saturated PL intensity. Despite this contrast, electronic structure calculations reveal nearly identical midgap states in both materials, indicating that electronic effects alone cannot explain the distinct PL responses. Phonon calculations likewise fail to capture this difference. In contrast, electron-phonon coupling calculations based on the deformation potential approach reveal significantly stronger coupling in Fe-doped CsPbCl$_3$, enabling efficient dissipation of electronic excitation energy into lattice vibrations and leading to complete PL quenching. These results identify electron-phonon coupling as the key factor governing halide-dependent PL quenching and provide a unified microscopic framework for dopant-induced nonradiative processes in halide perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算为主，辅以实验验证）。判断依据：关键词包括“spin-polarized density functional theory calculations”、“electronic structure calculations”、“phonon calculations”、“electron-phonon coupling calculations”以及“experimentally show”。；研究对象：Fe掺杂的卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶CsPbX₃（X = Cl, Br），具体研究Fe掺杂导致的光致发光（PL）淬灭现象及其卤素依赖性差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe掺杂在CsPbCl₃和CsPbBr₃中均引入几乎相同的Fe 3d中间隙态，但电子结构效应无法解释两者PL响应的差异；电子-声子耦合强度才是关键因素：Fe掺杂的CsPbCl₃中电子-声子耦合显著更强，导致激发能高效耗散为晶格振动，从而完全淬灭PL，而CsPbBr₃则保留有限饱和PL强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe掺杂在CsPbCl₃和CsPbBr₃中均引入几乎相同的Fe 3d中间隙态，但电子结构效应无法解释两者PL响应的差异；电子-声子耦合强度才是关键因素：Fe掺杂的CsPbCl₃中电子-声子耦合显著更强，导致激发能高效耗散为晶格振动，从而完全淬灭PL，而CsPbBr₃则保留有限饱和PL强度。；创新点：揭示了电子-声子耦合而非单纯的电子结构或声子谱是决定Fe掺杂卤化物钙钛矿中PL淬灭行为卤素依赖性的关键因素，为掺杂诱导的非辐射复合过程提供了统一的微观框架。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）计算（用于电子结构分析）、声子计算、基于形变势方法的电子-声子耦合计算；实验上通过测量Fe掺杂前后CsPbCl₃和CsPbBr₃的PL强度进行对比验证。

papers.title: Dipolar interlayer excitons in transition metal dichalcogenide alloy heterobilayers
papers.abstract: Interlayer excitons in transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterobilayers possess a permanent electric dipole moment and long recombination lifetimes, making them a promising platform for exploring excitonic many-body physics. Here, we report dipolar interlayer excitons in a MoS$_{1.4}$Se$_{0.6}$/MoSe$_2$ heterobilayer encapsulated in hexagonal boron nitride. Low-temperature photoluminescence measurements reveal a distinct emission peak at $\sim1.4$ eV, attributed to radiative recombination of interlayer excitons. The emission exhibits a blueshift with increasing excitation power, indicating repulsive dipole-dipole interactions. Time-resolved photoluminescence measurements uncover nanosecond-scale lifetimes, consistent with the spatial separation of electrons and holes across the two layers. These findings establish chalcogen-alloyed TMD heterobilayers as a versatile platform for engineering dipolar excitons and tuning excitonic interactions in van der Waals materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Low-temperature photoluminescence measurements”、“Time-resolved photoluminescence measurements”。；研究对象：过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）合金异质双层中的偶极层间激子。具体材料为六方氮化硼（hBN）封装的 MoS$_{1.4}$Se$_{0.6}$/MoSe$_2$ 异质双层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 MoS$_{1.4}$Se$_{0.6}$/MoSe$_2$ 合金异质双层中观测到了偶极层间激子，其发射峰位于约1.4 eV，具有纳秒级寿命，并且其发射能量随激发功率增加而蓝移，表明存在排斥性的偶极-偶极相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 MoS$_{1.4}$Se$_{0.6}$/MoSe$_2$ 合金异质双层中观测到了偶极层间激子，其发射峰位于约1.4 eV，具有纳秒级寿命，并且其发射能量随激发功率增加而蓝移，表明存在排斥性的偶极-偶极相互作用。；创新点：将硫族元素合金化的TMD异质双层（MoS$_{1.4}$Se$_{0.6}$/MoSe$_2$）确立为一种用于工程化偶极激子和调控激子相互作用的新平台。摘要未突出说明与纯TMD异质双层相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 低温光致发光（PL）光谱测量和瞬态光致发光（TRPL）测量。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou chain
papers.abstract: We provide a pedagogical review of the hydrodynamics of the FPUT chain. There are three hydrodynamic fields corresponding to the conservation of mass, momentum and energy. We provide physically motivated derivations of the hydrodynamic equations at the levels of Euler and then Navier-Stokes-Fourier. Next we consider examples to test as to how successful the hydrodynamic description is in predicting the observed time evolution of nonequilibrium initial conditions such as domain walls and blasts. We find that in some cases there is good agreement of microscopic simulations with predictions from the Euler equations while, in several other cases, there is significant departure from the Euler predictions suggesting that the role of dissipation and noise is important in general.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：pedagogical review、hydrodynamic equations、Euler、Navier-Stokes-Fourier、theoretical framework）；研究对象：Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou (FPUT) 链的流体动力学行为，具体涉及质量、动量和能量三个守恒场对应的流体动力学描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在某些非平衡初始条件（如畴壁和冲击波）下，微观模拟与欧拉方程预测吻合良好；但在其他多种情况下，欧拉预测与模拟结果存在显著偏差，表明耗散和噪声的作用普遍重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在某些非平衡初始条件（如畴壁和冲击波）下，微观模拟与欧拉方程预测吻合良好；但在其他多种情况下，欧拉预测与模拟结果存在显著偏差，表明耗散和噪声的作用普遍重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于守恒律推导欧拉级和纳维-斯托克斯-傅里叶级的流体动力学方程，并通过微观模拟与流体动力学预测的对比进行验证。

papers.title: Electron-Ion Path Integral Monte Carlo with Hard Core
papers.abstract: We performed numerical (restricted) path integral Monte Carlo experiments on metallic Hydrogen from first principles. We study a quantum two component plasma where one component is made of pointwise particles of negative unitary charge and the other is made of charged hard spheres of positive unitary charge. We study both the additive mixture and a nonadditive mixture where we only keep a hard core between unlike species. We specialize to the case of the electron-proton plasma with a 1:1 ratios between the molar fraction of the two species. We measured thermodynamic and structural properties of the plasma. From an analysis of the structure we see a transition from a metallic Hydrogen phase, to a molecular Hydrogen phase as the temperature is lowered. As expected at high density the correlations are diminished.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：path integral Monte Carlo experiments、first principles、numerical。；研究对象：金属氢（metallic Hydrogen）中的电子-质子等离子体（electron-proton plasma），具体为一种量子双组分等离子体，其中电子为点状负电荷粒子，质子为带正电的硬球。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分析结构，观察到随着温度降低，等离子体从金属氢相转变为分子氢相；在高密度下，粒子间的关联减弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分析结构，观察到随着温度降低，等离子体从金属氢相转变为分子氢相；在高密度下，粒子间的关联减弱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用（受限）路径积分蒙特卡洛方法（restricted path integral Monte Carlo），从第一性原理出发对量子双组分等离子体进行数值模拟。研究了两种混合类型：可加性混合（additive mixture）和仅保留异种粒子间硬核排斥的非可加性混合（nonadditive mixture）。

papers.title: Spectral criteria for generalization in unsupervised Hebbian nets
papers.abstract: We consider an unsupervised Hebbian network where the pairwise interactions among neurons are built on noisy realizations of hidden ground-truth vectors. Unlike classical Hopfield models, designed as memory devices, this class of networks can be employed to extract latent structure and generalize beyond the "training" set. By combining random matrix theory and replica methods, we derive the asymptotic spectrum of the corresponding interaction matrix and show that the onset of generalization is controlled by a sharp spectral transition. Depending on the quality and the size of the accessible dataset, the spectrum displays either two separated bulks, encoding informative and noisy directions, or a merged single-bulk phase where such distinction is lost. We show that, when coupled with regularization, the emergence of such a spectral split predicts the network's capability to reconstruct the ground-truth vectors from corrupted samples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：结合随机矩阵理论和复制方法（replica methods）进行理论推导，分析无监督Hebbian网络的谱性质。；研究对象：无监督Hebbian网络，一种基于神经元间成对相互作用的神经网络模型，用于从含噪声数据中提取隐藏的真实向量（ground-truth vectors）并实现泛化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 泛化能力的出现由相互作用矩阵谱中的尖锐相变控制：当数据集质量与大小满足条件时，谱呈现分离的双团块结构（分别对应信息方向和噪声方向），此时网络能通过正则化从含噪样本中重建真实向量；否则谱合并为单团块，无法区分信息与噪声。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：泛化能力的出现由相互作用矩阵谱中的尖锐相变控制：当数据集质量与大小满足条件时，谱呈现分离的双团块结构（分别对应信息方向和噪声方向），此时网络能通过正则化从含噪样本中重建真实向量；否则谱合并为单团块，无法区分信息与噪声。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 随机矩阵理论（random matrix theory）与复制方法（replica methods）相结合，推导相互作用矩阵的渐近谱，并分析谱分裂与泛化相变的关系。

papers.title: Functional trends and rheological evaluation of polyurethane microcapsules in dermato-cosmetic applications
papers.abstract: To date, natural and synthetic polymer-based microcapsules have been used extensively in various dermato-cosmetic applications, with an emphasis on the targeted delivery of active ingredients, including therapeutic and aesthetic interventions. Although numerous polymer candidates have been comprehensively investigated, polyurethane based microcapsules have received comparatively minor attention, despite possessing a multitude of intrinsic benefits. However, in recent years, although there has been an upsurge of studies involving polyurethane, predominantly as a capsule wall or shell component, towards tangible dermato-cosmetic applications, these are only intermittently documented. In the current review, we target this lacuna, explore, and collate only the most contemporary trends and advances (2017-to date) in the field. In addition, despite the significance, and pertaining to the acute deficiency of rheological studies targeting polyurethane-based microcapsules in dermato-cosmetic applications, we critically examine and lay a comprehensive interpretation, based on the current state-of-the-art, inevitability for systematic inquiries, and identification of several target domains that need urgent attention. Finally, we deliberate on the challenges and the impending projections from a diverse outlook. We focus on a steady and more sustainable path forward via incorporation of green raw materials, cumulative domain-optimized and customer-focused applications, and a significantly improved understanding of the microcapsule mechanical behavior via implementation of novel rheological characterization procedures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review, collate, contemporary trends and advances。；研究对象：用于皮肤-化妆品应用的聚氨酯微胶囊。具体研究其作为活性成分递送载体的功能趋势和流变学性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明一个具体的物理或化学发现。该综述旨在填补聚氨酯微胶囊在皮肤-化妆品应用领域文献记录不完整的空白，并指出当前缺乏针对该体系的流变学研究，强调了进行系统性流变学表征的必要性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明一个具体的物理或化学发现。该综述旨在填补聚氨酯微胶囊在皮肤-化妆品应用领域文献记录不完整的空白，并指出当前缺乏针对该体系的流变学研究，强调了进行系统性流变学表征的必要性。；创新点：该综述聚焦于近年来（2017年至今）聚氨酯微胶囊在皮肤-化妆品应用中的最新趋势，并特别指出了该领域流变学研究的严重不足，呼吁通过引入新型流变学表征方法来理解微胶囊的力学行为，并提出了结合绿色原料、优化应用场景的可持续发展路径。
papers.method_zh: 文献综述与批判性分析。作者对2017年至今的相关前沿研究进行了搜集、整理和解读，并基于现有技术对聚氨酯微胶囊的流变学行为进行了综合评述。

papers.title: Curvature-Controlled Infrared Regularization of Crystalline Membranes
papers.abstract: We show that negative Gaussian curvature regularizes the infrared sector of crystalline membranes. In a covariant formulation of embedded elasticity, the Green strain contains a symmetry-required linear coupling between the normal phonon and extrinsic curvature. Integrating out the in-plane phonons converts this coupling into a finite quadratic contribution to the inverse flexural response. Anomalous roughening is thereby replaced by curvature-controlled saturation, and the mechanism survives on minimal hyperbolic patches. Hyperbolic geometry preempts anomalous elasticity before the flat infrared regime is reached, implying the absence of a crumpling phase. The same Gaussian-order coupling admits sound propagation in the infrared.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“covariant formulation”“integrating out”“quadratic contribution”“anomalous roughening”“curvature-controlled saturation”等，均为理论推导和模型分析用语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：结晶膜（crystalline membranes）的红外行为，特别是负高斯曲率对其红外正则化的影响，以及与之相关的异常粗糙化、卷曲相变和声子传播等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 负高斯曲率能够对结晶膜的红外区域进行正则化，将原本的异常粗糙化行为替换为曲率控制的饱和，从而阻止了卷曲相的出现；同时，该曲率-声子耦合机制还允许红外区域存在声传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：负高斯曲率能够对结晶膜的红外区域进行正则化，将原本的异常粗糙化行为替换为曲率控制的饱和，从而阻止了卷曲相的出现；同时，该曲率-声子耦合机制还允许红外区域存在声传播。；创新点：首次指出负高斯曲率可以作为一种红外正则化机制，在平坦红外区域尚未达到之前就提前抑制异常弹性行为，从而否定结晶膜存在卷曲相。摘要未突出说明与已有理论（如平坦膜或正曲率膜）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用嵌入弹性理论的协变形式（covariant formulation of embedded elasticity），通过分析格林应变中法向声子与外禀曲率之间的线性耦合，并积分掉面内声子，得到对弯曲响应逆量的有限二次贡献。

papers.title: Correlated States in Quantum Dot Clusters Coupled to a Common Superconductor
papers.abstract: We study an effective model of regular quantum dot clusters coupled to a common superconductor. By applying a canonical transformation, we map the system onto a particle-number-conserving representation, making it directly accessible to standard fermionic neural-network quantum-state variational Monte Carlo methods. We show that the superconducting gap closes at a particular high-symmetry point, which, in finite non-interacting systems, corresponds to crossings between singlet ground states of different character. Combining exact methods, density matrix renormalization group, and neural quantum-state variational Monte Carlo calculations, we identify three distinct interacting regimes: a trivial superconducting singlet phase, a strongly correlated regime connected to an effective Heisenberg model, and a critical intermediate regime with qualitatively different behavior in one and two dimensions. In one-dimensional systems, the intermediate regime exhibits a sequence of singlet-doublet transitions and becomes gapless in the thermodynamic limit even for finite Coulomb interaction. In two-dimensional clusters, we find robust triplet ground states. Furthermore, our results demonstrate that relatively standard fermionic neural quantum states provide an efficient approach for correlated superconducting nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“有效模型”、“规范变换”、“变分蒙特卡洛”、“密度矩阵重正化群”等理论计算关键词。；研究对象：耦合到公共超导体的规则量子点团簇体系。具体研究该复合系统中由库仑相互作用和超导配对共同诱导的关联电子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出三种不同的相互作用区域：平庸的超导单态相、与有效海森堡模型相关的强关联区域，以及一个临界中间区域。在一维体系中，该中间区域表现为一系列单态-双态转变，并在热力学极限下变得无隙；在二维团簇中，则发现了稳定的三重态基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出三种不同的相互作用区域：平庸的超导单态相、与有效海森堡模型相关的强关联区域，以及一个临界中间区域。在一维体系中，该中间区域表现为一系列单态-双态转变，并在热力学极限下变得无隙；在二维团簇中，则发现了稳定的三重态基态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该方法上的创新在于：通过规范变换使系统适用于标准的费米子神经网络量子态方法，从而为研究关联超导纳米结构提供了一种高效的计算途径。
papers.method_zh: 1. 应用规范变换将系统映射到粒子数守恒表象。2. 使用标准费米子神经网络量子态变分蒙特卡洛方法进行数值计算。3. 结合精确对角化方法、密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）和神经网络量子态变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）进行交叉验证。

papers.title: Contact-network organization and motion statistics in shear-thickening suspensions
papers.abstract: We use lubricated-flow discrete-element-method (LF-DEM) simulations to examine how contact-network organization shapes particle motion in dense shear-thickening suspensions. The primary system studied is a two-dimensional bidisperse monolayer where rigid clusters are identified by the $(3,3)$ pebble game; three-dimensional simulations are shown to have qualitatively similar rotational velocity statistics. Across the stress--solid-fraction state diagram, frictional contact number, $k\ge 3$ percolation, and rigid-cluster fluctuations all strengthen in the same region where translational velocity correlations grow, consistent with rigid clusters translating coherently while the surrounding non-rigid particles accommodate a disproportionate share of the local velocity gradient. Rotational motion provides a complementary view: non-affine angular-velocity distributions broaden, near-contact rotations become increasingly anti-correlated, and rigid and non-rigid particles carry distinct statistics. Connectivity, rigidity, and velocity correlations are related but distinct signatures of the constrained collective motion that accompanies shear-thickening and the approach to shear jamming.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用“lubricated-flow discrete-element-method (LF-DEM) simulations”（润滑流离散元方法模拟）。；研究对象：剪切增稠悬浮液中的接触网络组织与颗粒运动统计，具体为二维双分散单层体系及三维对比体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在剪切增稠及接近剪切堵塞的区域，摩擦接触数、渗透性及刚性团簇涨落同时增强，并与平移速度关联增长一致；刚性团簇整体平移，而非刚性颗粒承担了大部分局部速度梯度。旋转运动则表现为非仿射角速度分布展宽、近接触旋转反关联增强，且刚性与非刚性颗粒具有不同的统计特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在剪切增稠及接近剪切堵塞的区域，摩擦接触数、渗透性及刚性团簇涨落同时增强，并与平移速度关联增长一致；刚性团簇整体平移，而非刚性颗粒承担了大部分局部速度梯度。旋转运动则表现为非仿射角速度分布展宽、近接触旋转反关联增强，且刚性与非刚性颗粒具有不同的统计特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用润滑流离散元方法（LF-DEM）进行模拟，通过(3,3)卵石游戏识别刚性团簇，分析应力-固相分数状态图上的接触网络与运动统计。

papers.title: Spin-polarization of the electric current in half-metallic Co$_2$MnSi Heusler thin films
papers.abstract: Using propagating spin wave spectroscopy we measure the spin wave Doppler shift in patterned MgO/Co$_2$MnSi/MgO thin films and determine the degree of spin-polarization of the electric current. Our measurements reveal that the current is fully spin-polarized in the devices. This shows that the half-metallic character of the electron band structure translates into a fully spin polarized current flowing across the patterned films. Additionally, we measure a current-induced change of the spin-wave attenuation from which we estimate the non-adiabatic spin-transfer-torque parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：propagating spin wave spectroscopy（传播自旋波谱学）、measurements（测量）、patterned thin films（图案化薄膜）。；研究对象：半金属Co₂MnSi Heusler合金薄膜（MgO/Co₂MnSi/MgO结构）中的自旋极化电流及自旋波多普勒效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验测量表明，在图案化的MgO/Co₂MnSi/MgO薄膜器件中，电流是完全自旋极化的，证实了半金属能带结构可转化为完全自旋极化的输运电流。此外，还测量了电流引起的自旋波衰减变化，并估算了非绝热自旋转移力矩参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验测量表明，在图案化的MgO/Co₂MnSi/MgO薄膜器件中，电流是完全自旋极化的，证实了半金属能带结构可转化为完全自旋极化的输运电流。此外，还测量了电流引起的自旋波衰减变化，并估算了非绝热自旋转移力矩参数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用传播自旋波谱学（propagating spin wave spectroscopy）测量图案化薄膜中的自旋波多普勒频移，从而确定电流的自旋极化度；同时通过电流引起的自旋波衰减变化估算非绝热自旋转移力矩参数。

papers.title: Efficient Magnetic Spin-Filtering and Persistent Spin-Currents in Lifshitz-Transitioned Altermagnets: A Route to Open-Orbit Spintronics
papers.abstract: Altermagnets offer a unique venue for spin transport due to their vanishing net magnetization and momentum-dependent spin splitting. We demonstrate that a homotopic Lifshitz transition in two-dimensional altermagnets creates a regime where carriers are confined to geometrically protected, spin-selective open channels. These channels originate from non-contractible Fermi contours and act as metallic analogues of topological edge modes: they are sharply directional, spin-pure, and protected by Fermi-surface winding rather than an energy gap or boundary confinement. We predict three striking magneto-transport signatures of such topologically reconfigured altermagnets: open-orbit focusing with perfect lensing and retroreflection, high-efficiency magnetic spin filtering, and chirality-tunable spin persistent currents in altermagnetic nanotubes. Our results establish altermagnets as a platform where Fermi-surface winding directly engineers spin transport, bypassing the requirements for ferromagnetism or strong spin-orbit coupling. These findings identify Lifshitz-transitioned altermagnets as a route to topology-enabled spintronics that transcends the limitations of conventional edge-state paradigms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”（论证）、“predict”（预测）等理论推导和预言性词汇，并基于拓扑概念（Fermi-surface winding）进行物理分析，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：经历同伦Lifshitz相变的二维交变磁体（altermagnets）及其中的自旋输运现象，特别是由非收缩费米轮廓（non-contractible Fermi contours）产生的自旋选择性开放通道。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维交变磁体中，通过同伦Lifshitz相变可以产生由费米面拓扑（非收缩费米轮廓）保护的、几何受限的自旋纯开放通道，这些通道能实现高效磁自旋过滤和手性可调的自旋持续电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维交变磁体中，通过同伦Lifshitz相变可以产生由费米面拓扑（非收缩费米轮廓）保护的、几何受限的自旋纯开放通道，这些通道能实现高效磁自旋过滤和手性可调的自旋持续电流。；创新点：提出利用交变磁体中的费米面拓扑（而非传统的能隙或边界束缚）来直接工程化自旋输运，从而绕过对铁磁性或强自旋-轨道耦合的需求，为超越传统边缘态范式的拓扑自旋电子学提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与拓扑论证。具体框架包括：基于费米面拓扑（Fermi-surface winding）的拓扑保护机制分析，以及针对开放轨道聚焦、磁自旋过滤和交变磁纳米管中自旋持续电流的磁输运特性预测。

papers.title: Antiferromagnetic Quantum Criticality in Infinite-Layer Cuprates Sr1-xNdxCuO2
papers.abstract: The interplay between quantum criticality and Fermi surface reconstruction is central to elucidating the phase diagram of high-temperature cuprate superconductors. While studies on electron-doped T'-structure cuprates suggest an antiferromagnetic origin of this reconstruction, quantitative consensus has been hindered by apical oxygen instabilities and uncontrolled oxygen vacancies. Here, we overcome these limitations by utilizing ozone-assisted molecular beam epitaxy to synthesize high-quality, oxygen-stoichiometric thin films of infinite-layer cuprate Sr1-xNdxCuO2 across its entire superconducting dome. Hall transport measurements reveal a sharp carrier-type transition signaling a Fermi surface reconstruction at a critical doping xc ~ 0.155. We show that a spin-density-wave tight-binding model quantitatively reproduces the transport evolution, supporting an antiferromagnetic origin of this quantum phase transition. Furthermore, upon suppressing superconductivity with magnetic fields, the normal-state resistivity exhibits a pristine strange metal behavior that persists down to 2 K in the vicinity of xc. Our findings establish an intrinsic, universal antiferromagnetic quantum criticality in electron-doped cuprates, positioning the structurally simplest infinite-layer cuprates as a clean benchmark platform for theories of unconventional superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“利用臭氧辅助分子束外延合成”、“霍尔输运测量”、“电阻率测量”。；研究对象：无限层铜氧化物超导体 Sr1-xNdxCuO2 中的反铁磁量子临界性及其与费米面重构的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电子掺杂的无限层铜氧化物 Sr1-xNdxCuO2 中，在临界掺杂浓度 xc ~ 0.155 处观测到由霍尔输运表征的载流子类型突变，表明发生了费米面重构。该量子相变起源于反铁磁序，并且在临界点附近，正常态电阻率表现出纯净的奇异金属行为，一直持续到 2 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电子掺杂的无限层铜氧化物 Sr1-xNdxCuO2 中，在临界掺杂浓度 xc ~ 0.155 处观测到由霍尔输运表征的载流子类型突变，表明发生了费米面重构。该量子相变起源于反铁磁序，并且在临界点附近，正常态电阻率表现出纯净的奇异金属行为，一直持续到 2 K。；创新点：通过合成结构最简单的无限层铜氧化物，克服了传统电子掺杂 T’ 结构铜氧化物中顶角氧不稳定和氧空位难以控制的问题，从而建立了电子掺杂铜氧化物中本征、普适的反铁磁量子临界性，为非常规超导理论提供了一个干净的基准平台。
papers.method_zh: 利用臭氧辅助分子束外延（MBE）技术合成高质量、氧化学计量比精确的 Sr1-xNdxCuO2 薄膜；通过霍尔输运测量表征载流子类型转变；采用自旋密度波（SDW）紧束缚模型对输运演化进行定量拟合。

papers.title: Probing PbTe-Pb nanowire devices with radio-frequency reflectometry
papers.abstract: We report the implementation of radio-frequency (rf) reflectometry on selective-area-grown PbTe-Pb nanowire devices on a CdTe substrate. These nanowires were predicted to host Majorana zero modes. We demonstrate the compatibility of the rf technique, both resistive and capacitive sensing, with these nanowires. The effect of dielectric loss from the CdTe substrate is also discussed. The feasibility of rf reflectometry is also verified at finite magnetic fields where zero-energy modes occur. Our results enable the fast control of PbTe quantum devices, paving the way for its application in topological quantum computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“implementation of radio-frequency (rf) reflectometry”、“demonstrate the compatibility”、“verified at finite magnetic fields”等实验操作与验证关键词。；研究对象：选择性区域生长的PbTe-Pb纳米线器件（位于CdTe衬底上），该体系被预测可承载马约拉纳零模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 射频反射测量技术（包括电阻式和电容式传感）可成功应用于PbTe-Pb纳米线器件，并在出现零能模的有限磁场下验证了其可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：射频反射测量技术（包括电阻式和电容式传感）可成功应用于PbTe-Pb纳米线器件，并在出现零能模的有限磁场下验证了其可行性。；创新点：首次将射频反射测量技术应用于PbTe-Pb纳米线体系，并验证了其在有限磁场下的兼容性，为快速调控PbTe量子器件及拓扑量子计算应用铺平道路。
papers.method_zh: 射频反射测量技术（rf reflectometry），包括电阻式传感和电容式传感两种模式；实验在CdTe衬底上进行，并讨论了衬底介电损耗的影响。

papers.title: Vibrational model of entropy in dense two-dimensional fluids
papers.abstract: A vibrational paradigm of atomic dynamic in dense fluids is known to provide useful insight on the transport and thermodynamic properties of fluids in three dimensions. In this paper, a vibrational model is generalized to describe the excess entropy of two-dimensional (2D) fluids. A simple practical implementation of this model is demonstrated to deliver accurate results for various systems, such as one-component plasmas with Coulomb and logarithmic interactions, a 2D fluid of dipole particles, and a 2D Yukawa fluid. The applicability limits, relevance to three-dimensional fluids, relations to other 2D phenomena, and potential practical applications are briefly discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：vibrational model（振动模型）、generalized（推广）、demonstrated to deliver accurate results（通过计算验证准确性）。；研究对象：二维稠密流体的熵，具体包括：具有库仑和对数相互作用的一组分等离子体、偶极粒子二维流体、二维Yukawa流体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将三维稠密流体中描述原子动力学的振动模型推广至二维，能够准确计算二维流体的过量熵（excess entropy）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将三维稠密流体中描述原子动力学的振动模型推广至二维，能够准确计算二维流体的过量熵（excess entropy）。；创新点：首次将振动模型从三维推广至二维流体，用于描述其过量熵，并展示了该模型在多种二维相互作用体系中的普适适用性。
papers.method_zh: 基于振动范式（vibrational paradigm）建立理论模型，并通过数值计算验证该模型在多种二维流体体系（如等离子体、偶极流体、Yukawa流体）中的准确性。

papers.title: Mechanical bistability and hysteresis in graphene-CNT hybrid systems: from atomistic simulations to macroscale structural responses
papers.abstract: Hybrid systems composed of graphene (Gr) and carbon nanotubes (CNTs), such as films and aerogels, have attracted broad attention for applications in electronics, mechanics, energy, and environmental science. Since the microstructures of Gr-CNT hybrids strongly affect their properties, it is essential to establish mechanical principles that govern these structures. In this study, we investigated the structural stability and mechanical behavior of Gr-CNT hybrid systems by combining molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and nanoindentation experiments. MD simulations of stacked Gr-CNT structures, in which two Gr layers confine CNTs between them, identified the energetically stable configurations and their governing parameters, i.e., intertube spacing, CNT diameter, and wall number. Specifically, under certain conditions, the structures exhibit mechanical bistability with two stable configurations: adhesion and separation of the Gr layers, arising from the competition between interlayer van der Waals attraction and elastic deformation of Gr and CNTs. Simulated loading--unloading curves display hysteresis and energy dissipation related to the stable configurations. In addition, reduced graphene oxide (rGO)-CNT hybrid films were experimentally fabricated as macroscopic assemblies of the unit structures modeled in the simulations. Atomic force microscopy-based nanoindentation measurements on the rGO-CNT films exhibit clear hysteresis and higher dissipation energy compared with pure rGO, in good agreement with the simulation results. These results provide valuable insights into Gr-CNT hybrid systems and offer guidance for designing microstructures with enhanced properties for advanced applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：结合了分子动力学（MD）模拟和纳米压痕实验。；研究对象：石墨烯-碳纳米管（Gr-CNT）杂化体系的结构稳定性与力学行为，具体包括堆叠的Gr-CNT单元结构（两层石墨烯夹持碳纳米管）以及宏观还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）-CNT杂化薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定条件下，Gr-CNT杂化结构表现出力学双稳态（石墨烯层间粘附与分离两种稳定构型），其源于层间范德华吸引力与石墨烯及碳纳米管弹性形变之间的竞争；加载-卸载曲线呈现迟滞和能量耗散，且宏观rGO-CNT薄膜实验与模拟结果吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定条件下，Gr-CNT杂化结构表现出力学双稳态（石墨烯层间粘附与分离两种稳定构型），其源于层间范德华吸引力与石墨烯及碳纳米管弹性形变之间的竞争；加载-卸载曲线呈现迟滞和能量耗散，且宏观rGO-CNT薄膜实验与模拟结果吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟用于研究堆叠Gr-CNT单元结构的稳定构型及其控制参数（管间距、CNT直径、壁数）；基于原子力显微镜（AFM）的纳米压痕实验用于测量宏观rGO-CNT杂化薄膜的力学响应。

papers.title: When Screening Current Controls Ferroelectric Switching: From Field-Limited to Current-Limited Regimes under an SPM Tip
papers.abstract: Tip-induced switching in ferroelectrics is commonly framed as a field-driven process controlled by domain-wall kinetics. Here we argue for a more universal viewpoint: under a scanning probe, polarization reversal is fundamentally constrained by how fast screening charge can be supplied and redistributed. By combining local switching experiments with finite-element simulations, we identify a screening-current-limited mechanism in which charge injection and its space-charge-limited relaxation set the pace of switching and the scaling of domain growth. This framework naturally explains regime changes and the apparent breakdown of intrinsic domain-wall laws often inferred in the nanoscale piezoelectric hysteresis measurements. Beyond a reinterpretation of tip switching, the results position screening currents as a hidden control parameter of ferroelectric reversal across materials, turning current regulation into a practical handle for deterministic nanoscale domain engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据关键词：combining local switching experiments with finite-element simulations。；研究对象：铁电材料中扫描探针诱导的极化翻转过程，特别是屏蔽电流对翻转动力学的控制作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扫描探针下，铁电体的极化翻转本质上受限于屏蔽电荷的供应与再分布速度，而非传统认为的仅由畴壁动力学控制的场驱动过程。这一屏蔽电流限制机制可解释纳米尺度压电滞后测量中观察到的畴壁定律表观失效现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扫描探针下，铁电体的极化翻转本质上受限于屏蔽电荷的供应与再分布速度，而非传统认为的仅由畴壁动力学控制的场驱动过程。这一屏蔽电流限制机制可解释纳米尺度压电滞后测量中观察到的畴壁定律表观失效现象。；创新点：提出屏蔽电流作为铁电翻转的隐藏控制参数，将传统场驱动视角扩展为电流限制视角，并揭示从场限制到电流限制的机制转变，为确定性纳米尺度畴工程提供了电流调控这一实用手段。
papers.method_zh: 局部翻转实验（local switching experiments）结合有限元模拟（finite-element simulations）。

papers.title: Perfect Nonreciprocal Axion-polaritons
papers.abstract: Dynamical axion describes a massive axion quasiparticle that arises from fluctuations of the magnetic order parameter. These fluctuations couple to electromagnetic fields, forming axion-polaritons -- collective modes that are physically magnon-polaritons. We show that under appropriate static external electric and magnetic fields, axion-polaritons acquire a nonreciprocal dispersion, $ω(\textbf{k}) \neq ω(-\textbf{k})$, arising intrinsically from direction-dependent axion-photon coupling. Strikingly, we identify a regime of \textit{perfect nonreciprocity} in which the photon propagating in one direction is completely decoupled from the axion while the counter-propagating photon hybridizes strongly. Furthermore, the nonreciprocal dispersion manifests as an optical isolator -- a device transmitting light preferentially in one direction. Our results establish nonreciprocal axion-polaritons as a powerful probe of axion quasiparticles and suggest experimentally accessible routes for their detection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show”、“We identify”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：动态轴子（dynamical axion）准粒子及其与电磁场耦合形成的轴子-极化激元（axion-polaritons），具体物理现象为在静态外电场和外磁场下该体系中的非互易色散与完美非互易性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在适当的静态外电场和外磁场下，轴子-极化激元会获得非互易色散（ω(k) ≠ ω(-k)），并存在一个“完美非互易”区域：沿一个方向传播的光子与轴子完全退耦合，而反向传播的光子则发生强杂化。该非互易色散可表现为光学隔离器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在适当的静态外电场和外磁场下，轴子-极化激元会获得非互易色散（ω(k) ≠ ω(-k)），并存在一个“完美非互易”区域：沿一个方向传播的光子与轴子完全退耦合，而反向传播的光子则发生强杂化。该非互易色散可表现为光学隔离器。；创新点：首次提出并证明了轴子-极化激元中可实现“完美非互易性”，即单向光子与轴子完全退耦合而反向光子强杂化，并指出该效应可作为探测轴子准粒子的实验手段。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于动态轴子与电磁场耦合的模型，通过考虑方向依赖的轴子-光子耦合来推导非互易色散。摘要未明确说明具体数学方法（如有效场论或哈密顿量对角化）。

papers.title: Effect of cations on van der Waals interactions between particles in aqueous alkali nitrate electrolytes
papers.abstract: The van der Waals interaction has been extensively studied for colloidal forces and resultant emergent phenomena such as colloidal stability, aggregation, and suspension rheology, but the effect of electrolytes on this interaction, especially at intermediate and high electrolyte concentrations, remains incompletely understood. We have extended the Lifshitz theory for van der Waals interactions in pure water to alkali nitrate solutions at arbitrary concentrations by developing a dielectric response model for alkali nitrate solutions that is based on electronic structure calculations of the molecular constituents. Due to their importance in catalysis, ceramics, and coating technologies, the Hamaker constants for rutile, boehmite, and alumina nanoparticles suspended in alkali nitrate solutions are calculated as a function of salt concentration. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, increasing the concentration of sodium (Na), potassium (K), and rubidium (Rb) nitrate solutions causes appreciable increases of the Hamaker constants relative to pure water instead of decreases, whereas cesium nitrate (CsNO3) has almost no effect on the Hamaker constant. We discussed the influence of the solution molar volume, the polarizability of the dissolved ions, and optical properties of the interacting particles in the context of previously published work. Our study indicates a non-vanishing role of van der Waals interactions on colloidal stability at intermediate and high electrolyte concentrations, leading to physical insights on emergent phenomena associated with nanoparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：extended the Lifshitz theory、dielectric response model、electronic structure calculations。；研究对象：碱金属硝酸盐水溶液中纳米颗粒（金红石、勃姆石、氧化铝）之间的范德华相互作用，以及阳离子（Na⁺、K⁺、Rb⁺、Cs⁺）对该作用的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中高浓度下，NaNO₃、KNO₃、RbNO₃溶液浓度的增加会显著提高Hamaker常数（相对于纯水），而CsNO₃几乎无影响，推翻了以往认为电解质会降低范德华作用的假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中高浓度下，NaNO₃、KNO₃、RbNO₃溶液浓度的增加会显著提高Hamaker常数（相对于纯水），而CsNO₃几乎无影响，推翻了以往认为电解质会降低范德华作用的假设。；创新点：首次系统计算了中高浓度碱金属硝酸盐溶液中阳离子种类对纳米颗粒间范德华相互作用的影响，揭示了与普遍假设相反的浓度依赖趋势。
papers.method_zh: 基于分子组分的电子结构计算，发展了碱金属硝酸盐水溶液的介电响应模型，并将Lifshitz理论从纯水推广到任意浓度的碱金属硝酸盐溶液，进而计算不同盐浓度下纳米颗粒的Hamaker常数。

papers.title: Morphogenesis driven by nematic defects in active biological networks
papers.abstract: Cellular morphogenesis, the process by which biological tissues acquire shape and structure, remains a fundamental challenge in understanding pattern formation and the coordinated remodeling of cellular assemblies. Under appropriate conditions, cytoskeletal filaments can organize into a nematic phase exhibiting partial orientational order. Topological defects within this nematic organization generate localized mechanical stresses that destabilize the tissue and promote deformation and structural rearrangements to relieve internal stresses. We develop a continuum framework that models living tissues as active biological networks represented as nematic polymer networks capable of heterogeneous growth and remodeling. The model captures macroscopic effects through spatial variations in the fiber order parameter which drives the system away from equilibrium. Morphogenesis is described as a sequence of quasi-static equilibrium states governed by the coupling between nematic order, elasticity, stress-driven growth, and adaptive relaxation. Finite element simulations illustrate Hydra regeneration and development when topological defects are prescribed according to the mature organism's expected morphology. The results show that defect topology controls stress localization and shape evolution: $+1$ defects drive protrusion formation, while $-1/2$ defects act as structural stabilizers with minimal growth. By varying the initial defect configuration, we model diverse morphogenetic outcomes, including uniaxial regeneration, tentacle formation, and biaxial development.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：continuum framework（连续介质框架）、finite element simulations（有限元模拟）、model（模型）。；研究对象：生物组织形态发生（morphogenesis），具体为活性生物网络（active biological networks）中由向列相缺陷（nematic defects）驱动的细胞骨架重组与形状演化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 向列相缺陷的拓扑类型控制应力局域化和形状演化：+1缺陷驱动突起形成，-1/2缺陷作为结构稳定剂抑制生长；通过改变初始缺陷构型可模拟单轴再生、触手形成和双轴发育等多种形态发生结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：向列相缺陷的拓扑类型控制应力局域化和形状演化：+1缺陷驱动突起形成，-1/2缺陷作为结构稳定剂抑制生长；通过改变初始缺陷构型可模拟单轴再生、触手形成和双轴发育等多种形态发生结果。；创新点：将拓扑缺陷的拓扑类型（+1与-1/2）与形态发生的具体模式（突起形成 vs. 结构稳定）直接关联，并通过预设成熟生物体预期形态的缺陷构型来模拟水螅再生过程。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个连续介质理论框架，将活体组织建模为能够异质性生长和重塑的向列聚合物网络（nematic polymer networks）。模型通过纤维序参量的空间变化驱动系统远离平衡，并耦合向列序、弹性、应力驱动生长和自适应松弛来描述准静态平衡序列。采用有限元模拟（finite element simulations）对水螅（Hydra）再生与发育过程进行数值计算。

papers.title: High-density, high-mobility ultrathin spin-polarized two-dimensional electron gas at the polar/polar LaVO$_3$/KTaO$_3$ interface: Insights from first-principles calculations
papers.abstract: The emergence of high-mobility two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) at oxide interfaces provides a fertile platform for exploring emergent quantum phenomena and next-generation oxide electronics. Here, using first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we investigate the microscopic origin of the 2DEG formed at the interface between the band insulator KTaO$_3$ (KTO) and the Mott insulator LaVO$_3$ (LVO). Although both constituents are insulating in bulk, the LVO/KTO heterostructure develops robust metallicity at the interface, consistent with experimental observations. Our calculations show that this metallic state originates from an electronic reconstruction driven by the polar discontinuity across the interface. To avoid the polar catastrophe on both the polar LVO film and the polar KTO substrate, electrons are transferred from the outer surfaces toward the interface, leading to hole accumulation in the surface VO$_2$ layer and electron accumulation in the interfacial TaO$_2$ layer. This charge redistribution stabilizes a highly confined and spin-polarized 2DEG localized at the interface. The electronic states forming the 2DEG are predominantly derived from interfacial Ta $5d_{xy}$ orbitals, confining carrier motion to the interfacial plane. Remarkably, the spin-up parabolic band hosting the 2DEG exhibits an exceptionally small effective mass, substantially lower than that of the prototypical LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ interface, indicating the potential for enhanced carrier mobility. Furthermore, the calculated interfacial electron density is nearly an order of magnitude larger than that of LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$, consistent with experiment. These findings identify the LVO/KTO heterostructure as a promising platform for realizing high-density, high-mobility spin-polarized 2DEGs and for engineering correlated oxide interfaces for quantum electronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations、first-principles calculations。；研究对象：LaVO₃/KTaO₃（LVO/KTO）极性/极性氧化物异质结界面处形成的二维电子气（2DEG）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LVO/KTO界面通过极性不连续驱动的电子重构，形成高度受限且自旋极化的二维电子气，该2DEG具有比LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃界面更小的有效质量和近一个数量级更高的电子密度，有望实现高密度、高迁移率的自旋极化二维电子气。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LVO/KTO界面通过极性不连续驱动的电子重构，形成高度受限且自旋极化的二维电子气，该2DEG具有比LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃界面更小的有效质量和近一个数量级更高的电子密度，有望实现高密度、高迁移率的自旋极化二维电子气。；创新点：揭示了极性/极性（而非传统极性/非极性）氧化物界面（LVO/KTO）中2DEG的微观起源，并发现该体系在载流子有效质量和电子密度上均显著优于经典的LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃界面，为高迁移率自旋极化2DEG提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Physical properties of R$_2$Co$_6$Al$_{20-δ}$ (R = Gd-Tm, Y) single crystals
papers.abstract: Rare-earth (R) based intermetallic compounds can often exhibit diverse physical properties and distinct magnetic anisotropies. A Notable example are the light rare earth members of the mono-clinic, R$_2$Co$_6$Al$_{19}$ series that are known to display a range of physical properties, from non-Fermi liquid behavior to antiferromagnetic (AFM) ordering, with properties that vary depending on R. In this work, we have extended this series to the heavy rare earths and systematically investigate the synthesis, crystal structure, and physical properties of single crystals of R$_2$Co$_6$Al$_{20-δ}$ for R = Gd - Tm and Y. Single crystal X-ray diffraction reveals that these materials adopt an orthorhombic Imma-type structure with delta varying non-monotonically across the heavy rare earths; ranging from 0.73 for Dy to 0.91 for Gd. Temperature-dependent specific heat, resistivity, and magnetization measurements demonstrate AFM ordering in all materials, with the Neel temperature (TN) ranging from 1.8 K for Ho to 11.8 K for Tb. Notably, Gd and Tb-based materials exhibit two distinct AFM transitions, separated by approximately 2 - 3 K. These findings establish the heavy rare-earth members of the R2Co6Al20-delta series as anisotropic antiferromagnets with strong crystal electric field effects and exchange anisotropy. The observed deviation from de Gennes scaling and the anisotropy crossover across the series highlight the important interplay between RKKY exchange and crystal electric field interactions in this orthorhombic system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synthesis, single crystal X-ray diffraction, specific heat, resistivity, magnetization measurements。；研究对象：重稀土基R₂Co₆Al₂₀₋δ（R = Gd-Tm, Y）单晶系列，具体研究其晶体结构、磁有序和物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有重稀土成员均呈现反铁磁（AFM）有序，奈尔温度（TN）在1.8 K（Ho）至11.8 K（Tb）之间；Gd和Tb基材料表现出两个不同的反铁磁相变（间隔约2-3 K）。该系列是各向异性反铁磁体，具有强晶场效应和交换各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有重稀土成员均呈现反铁磁（AFM）有序，奈尔温度（TN）在1.8 K（Ho）至11.8 K（Tb）之间；Gd和Tb基材料表现出两个不同的反铁磁相变（间隔约2-3 K）。该系列是各向异性反铁磁体，具有强晶场效应和交换各向异性。；创新点：将之前仅限于轻稀土成员的R₂Co₆Al₁₉系列扩展至重稀土（Gd-Tm, Y），并系统研究了其结构（δ随重稀土非单调变化）和物理性质，揭示了偏离de Gennes标度以及各向异性交叉现象，强调了RKKY交换与晶场相互作用的竞争。
papers.method_zh: 采用单晶X射线衍射确定晶体结构（正交Imma型）；通过变温比热、电阻率和磁化率测量表征磁相变和输运性质。

papers.title: Breaking the width-scaling limit in high-performance atomically thin 2D nanoribbon transistors
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art transistors have been successfully scaled the gate lengths and channel thicknesses down to 5 nm for high-performance and energy-efficient information processing. However, reducing channel width below 40-50 nm remains a bottleneck, as dangling bonds, edge disorder, and lateral depletion suppress drive current and degrade device performance. Here, we break this width-scaling wall using ultra-scaled two-dimensional semiconductor (2DSC) nanoribbon transistors down to 15 nm. In contrast to the conventional scaling rule of degradation of current density upon width scaling, our atomically-thin monolayer and bilayer molybdenum disulfide nanoribbon transistors exhibit enhancement of on-current density of up to 230% and 170%,respectively, followed by a saturation for the narrowest channels down to 15 nm. The ultra-narrow nanoribbon transistors maintain the highest on/off ratios reported so far for similar device dimensions, with improved mobility and threshold-voltage stability, indicating reduced edge scattering and depletion with a stronger electrostatic control. These findings lead to a breakthrough in width scaling rules using 2DSC nanoribbons with enhanced performance at narrower channel widths, which is promising for the ultimate scaling of transistors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：exhibit、measured、maintain、findings（描述器件性能的实验结果）。；研究对象：基于单层和双层二硫化钼（MoS₂）的原子级薄二维半导体纳米带晶体管，研究其宽度缩小至15纳米时的电学性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在宽度缩小至15纳米时，原子级薄的MoS₂纳米带晶体管的导通电流密度不降反升（单层提升230%，双层提升170%），打破了传统晶体管宽度缩小的性能退化瓶颈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在宽度缩小至15纳米时，原子级薄的MoS₂纳米带晶体管的导通电流密度不降反升（单层提升230%，双层提升170%），打破了传统晶体管宽度缩小的性能退化瓶颈。；创新点：首次实验证明，在二维半导体纳米带晶体管中，缩小沟道宽度可以增强而非降低导通电流密度，突破了传统硅基晶体管40-50纳米的宽度缩放极限。
papers.method_zh: 制备了宽度缩小至15纳米的单层和双层MoS₂纳米带晶体管，测量了导通电流密度、开关比、迁移率和阈值电压稳定性等电学性能参数。

papers.title: Emergence of Macroscopic Quantum Order via Translational Zero Modes
papers.abstract: Macroscopic quantum coherence in solids, such as in superfluids, superconductors, and condensates, is generally limited to low temperatures because order forms within a fixed excitation spectrum whose competing states become thermally populated as temperature rises. Here, we show that strong coupling between electronic excitations and a deformable lattice enables a different route. Above a critical density, this coupling nucleates self generated confining potentials that trap the very excitations generating them. Unlike rigid external traps, these potentials can translate through the host lattice without changing their internal structure, defining a translational zero mode. Coupling to this zero mode provides a shared dynamical coordinate that lowers and isolates a single collective many body configuration, opening a density dependent gap that suppresses thermal occupation of competing states and supports off diagonal long range order at elevated temperatures. As a concrete realization, we identify high-temperature superfluorescence in lead halide perovskites as the radiative instability of this zero mode dressed ordered excitonic state. More broadly, this establishes a general route to macroscopic quantum order: not cooling within a fixed spectrum, nor pairing instabilities, but a self generated mobile confining structure whose translational zero mode reconstructs the many-body spectrum to protect coherence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、establishes、general route、theoretical framework（摘要中未提及具体实验或计算手段，以理论论证和概念提出为主）。；研究对象：宏观量子有序态（如超流、超导、凝聚体）在高温下的实现机制，具体以铅卤钙钛矿中的高温超荧光作为实例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子激发与可变形晶格之间的强耦合可以产生自生束缚势，该势具有平移零模，通过耦合到这一零模可重构多体能谱，在高温下保护离域长程有序，从而开辟一条不依赖传统冷却或配对不稳定性、而是通过自生可移动束缚结构实现宏观量子有序的新路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子激发与可变形晶格之间的强耦合可以产生自生束缚势，该势具有平移零模，通过耦合到这一零模可重构多体能谱，在高温下保护离域长程有序，从而开辟一条不依赖传统冷却或配对不稳定性、而是通过自生可移动束缚结构实现宏观量子有序的新路径。；创新点：提出一种全新的宏观量子有序形成机制：不依赖于在固定激发谱中降温或配对不稳定性，而是通过自生可移动束缚结构及其平移零模来保护量子相干性，为高温量子有序提供了普适性理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于电子-晶格强耦合模型，论证自生束缚势的成核条件、平移零模的存在及其对多体能谱的重构效应，并识别铅卤钙钛矿中的高温超荧光为该零模修饰的有序激子态的辐射不稳定性。

papers.title: Electronic primary thermometry -- experimental comparison of the Coulomb Blockade and Shot Noise Thermometer
papers.abstract: Since the redefinition of the kelvin in 2019, new methods of primary thermometry have been considered to replace the currently agreed temperature scale in the very high and low temperature limits. These new methods should provide improved uncertainties and, most importantly, a more direct link to the definition of the kelvin. In the low temperature ranges it is possible to realize thermometers that do not require any known reference temperature or external calibration parameters. We present an experimental comparison of two such thermometers: the Coulomb Blockade Thermometer (CBT) and the Shot Noise Thermometer (SNT). Both thermometers measure temperature hinging only on the natural constants $k_\mathrm{B}$, and $e$. Furthermore both of them are based on electron tunneling current and, thereby, need only electrical measurements, enhancing the practicality. CBT and the SNT are inter-compared in a range of 20 mK to 235 mK. The results show that the agreement of SNT and CBT is approximately within 2.5 % in this range. Basic measurement uncertainty is analyzed and we show that uncertainty in the measurement frequency can cause significant error. to temperature measurement of the SNT at low temperatures where finite frequency plays a role.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimental comparison、inter-compared、measurement uncertainty analyzed。；研究对象：两种基于电子隧穿电流的初级温度计：库仑阻塞温度计（CBT）和散粒噪声温度计（SNT），在20 mK至235 mK低温范围内的性能比较。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在20 mK至235 mK范围内，CBT与SNT的测量结果一致性约为2.5%以内；测量频率的不确定性在低温下会对SNT的温度测量引入显著误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在20 mK至235 mK范围内，CBT与SNT的测量结果一致性约为2.5%以内；测量频率的不确定性在低温下会对SNT的温度测量引入显著误差。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验对比两种温度计（CBT和SNT）在同一低温范围内的温度测量结果，两者均仅依赖自然常数 \(k_\mathrm{B}\) 和 \(e\)，通过电学测量实现温度测定。分析了基本测量不确定度，特别关注了有限频率效应对SNT低温测量的影响。

papers.title: Moiré enabled spin pumping and preservation in MoSe2/WS2 heterobilayers
papers.abstract: The spin degree of freedom is a fundamental quantum mechanical attribute with implications spanning from magnetism to quantum computing. Consequently, the relaxation of spin states for extended, Bloch electrons in solids has been studied for decades as it defines many of their properties and applications. We show that moiré patterns in layered materials can extend spin relaxation times by two orders of magnitude to 1 millisecond and beyond. This is achieved by suppressing spin mixing for electrons in 2D semiconductor heterostructures, particularly in the MoSe2/WS2 system, as we elucidate both experimentally and theoretically. The extended longitudinal lifetime facilitates spin alignment over 50% using only nanowatt levels of optical power. Our findings highlight the potential of moiré engineering for future quantum sensing and information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“elucidate both experimentally and theoretically”。；研究对象：MoSe2/WS2异质双层中的莫尔超晶格及其对自旋弛豫时间的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 莫尔图案可将二维半导体异质结中电子的自旋弛豫时间延长两个数量级，达到1毫秒以上，并能在仅纳瓦级光功率下实现超过50%的自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：莫尔图案可将二维半导体异质结中电子的自旋弛豫时间延长两个数量级，达到1毫秒以上，并能在仅纳瓦级光功率下实现超过50%的自旋极化。；创新点：首次在MoSe2/WS2莫尔异质结中实现自旋弛豫时间的大幅延长（至毫秒级），并展示极低光功率下的高效自旋极化，凸显莫尔工程在量子传感与信息处理中的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光学手段（如自旋注入与探测）测量自旋寿命；理论上通过分析莫尔势对自旋混合的抑制机制进行解释。

papers.title: Controlled Chemical Signaling between Enzymatic Nanomotors
papers.abstract: The coordinated interactions between organisms enhance collective functionality, a feature that artificial systems such as enzymatic nanomotors seek to replicate. A key objective, yet still a major challenge, is to achieve chemical communication among nanomotors. Progress has been limited by the difficulties in verifying effective signaling processes, including chemical signal propagation and the response of receiving nanomotors. Here, we address this challenge using an enzymatic nanomotor system that demonstrates communication between two populations through generically non-reciprocal phoretic response. A primary swarm of glucose-responsive nanomotors migrates toward a glucose gradient while producing H2O2 as a diffusible communication signal. This self-generated chemical gradient then acts as a chemoattractant for a secondary swarm of catalase-powered nanomotors. Through carefully designed experiments, we visualize the propagating H2O2 gradient and quantify the spatiotemporal response of the receiver nanomotors to the chemical front. Combined experimental and theoretical analysis has revealed that the synergy between different combinations of chemo-attractive and chemo-repulsive mobilities and catalytic rates of consumption and production of substrates and products gives rise to a wealth of different collective responses in the system. This work represents a step toward programmable synthetic systems at the collective level, broadening the functionality of chemical nanomotors and opening opportunities for future hybrid living-synthetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论分析）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“通过精心设计的实验”以及“结合实验和理论分析”。；研究对象：酶促纳米马达之间的化学信号通讯系统。具体体系为：由葡萄糖驱动的纳米马达（初级群体）和由过氧化氢酶驱动的纳米马达（次级群体）构成的二元群体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计非互易的趋药性响应，实现了两种酶促纳米马达群体之间的化学通讯：初级群体在葡萄糖梯度中迁移并产生H₂O₂信号，该信号作为化学吸引剂引导次级群体的时空响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计非互易的趋药性响应，实现了两种酶促纳米马达群体之间的化学通讯：初级群体在葡萄糖梯度中迁移并产生H₂O₂信号，该信号作为化学吸引剂引导次级群体的时空响应。；创新点：首次在酶促纳米马达系统中实验验证并量化了通过自生化学信号（H₂O₂）实现的两个群体之间的有效通讯过程，克服了此前难以验证信号传播和接收响应的挑战。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，通过可视化传播的H₂O₂梯度并量化接收纳米马达对化学前沿的时空响应来验证通讯过程。理论上，结合了实验与理论分析，揭示了不同趋化性迁移率与底物/产物消耗/产生催化速率之间的协同作用如何导致丰富的集体响应。

papers.title: Probing pairing symmetries through quasiparticle interference in chiral Bloch bands
papers.abstract: Recent experiments in van der Waals multi-layer systems have demonstrated that superconductivity can emerge from symmetry-reduced, chiral normal states. We here provide a theory for quasiparticle interference (QPI) of superconductors with chiral Bloch bands. Our analysis reveals how the non-trivial quantum geometry of the Bloch states crucially affects the interference pattern even in the normal state, inducing significant sublattice dependence. In the superconducting state, the behavior becomes more complex due to the interplay of the quantum geometry of the Bogoliubov quasiparticles with the momentum-dependent phase of the order parameter. We reveal how the spatial dependence of the local spectral function around impurities can be used to distinguish between different candidate pairing states, both with zero and finite center-of-mass momentum. Our work thus provides guidance to interpreting QPI patterns in materials with chiral bands, which may be useful when probing the rich physics of pairing in such systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theory、analysis、reveal。；研究对象：具有手性布洛赫能带的超导体中的准粒子干涉（QPI）现象，具体针对范德华多层体系中由对称性降低的手性正常态产生的超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了布洛赫态的非平凡量子几何即使在正常态下也会显著影响准粒子干涉图案，并产生子晶格依赖；在超导态中，博戈留波夫准粒子的量子几何与序参量的动量依赖相位相互耦合，使得局域谱函数的空间分布可用于区分不同配对态（包括零质心动量和有限质心动量配对）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了布洛赫态的非平凡量子几何即使在正常态下也会显著影响准粒子干涉图案，并产生子晶格依赖；在超导态中，博戈留波夫准粒子的量子几何与序参量的动量依赖相位相互耦合，使得局域谱函数的空间分布可用于区分不同配对态（包括零质心动量和有限质心动量配对）。；创新点：首次系统分析了手性布洛赫能带中量子几何对超导态准粒子干涉图案的影响，并提出了利用局域谱函数空间依赖区分零质心与有限质心动量配对态的方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于手性布洛赫能带超导体的准粒子干涉（QPI）模型，结合量子几何（量子度规、贝里曲率等）与超导序参量的相位结构。

papers.title: Quantum String Interactions Revealed by Full Counting Statistics
papers.abstract: How quantum strings interact is a basic question for extended objects in quantum many-body physics. Even the simplest hard-core constraint (no crossing), can generate a nontrivial effective potential, whose microscopic form is difficult to determine because the relative distance between the strings is intrinsically nonlocal. Here we show that this nonlocality is naturally captured by full counting statistics (FCS). For two hard-core quantum strings, we derive an analytic FCS expression for the emergent interaction by identifying the virtual process in which the two strings touch and hop back. Using the FCS--entanglement relation, we find the effective potential has the entanglement-controlled asymptotic form $\lnΔE(r)\sim -π^2 r^2/(12 S_\ell)$ up to subleading terms, where $S_\ell$ is the entanglement entropy between the two halves of a quantum string. We confirm the theory using high-precision numerical calculations and finite-size FCS estimates. Our results reveal FCS as a direct route to effective interactions between quantum topological line-defects, which may also be extended to higher-form charge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive an analytic FCS expression”、“the theory”、“high-precision numerical calculations”。；研究对象：量子弦（quantum strings）之间的相互作用，特别是硬核约束（不可交叉）下两个量子弦之间的有效势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过全计数统计（FCS）可以自然捕捉量子弦相互作用的非局域性，并推导出有效势的渐近形式为 \(\ln\Delta E(r)\sim -\pi^2 r^2/(12 S_\ell)\)，其中 \(S_\ell\) 是量子弦两半之间的纠缠熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过全计数统计（FCS）可以自然捕捉量子弦相互作用的非局域性，并推导出有效势的渐近形式为 \(\ln\Delta E(r)\sim -\pi^2 r^2/(12 S_\ell)\)，其中 \(S_\ell\) 是量子弦两半之间的纠缠熵。；创新点：首次将全计数统计（FCS）作为直接工具用于揭示量子拓扑线缺陷（量子弦）之间的有效相互作用，并建立了相互作用势与纠缠熵之间的定量关系。摘要未突出说明与以往具体工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 全计数统计（FCS）解析推导，结合FCS-纠缠熵关系，以及高精度数值计算和有限尺寸FCS估计进行验证。

papers.title: Multiparametric Quantum Sensing of Liquids Using NV Centres and Tethered Magnetic Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: We propose a new concept for non-invasive, multiparametric liquid analysis based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre magnetometry, relaxometry and surface-tethered magnetic nanoparticles. Magnetic nanoparticles are anchored to a diamond surface via DNA strands, forming nanoscale mechanical oscillators whose thermally driven motion is strongly influenced by the surrounding liquid environment. The resulting time-dependent magnetic fields couple to near-surface NV centres and are detected via optically detected magnetic resonance or changes in spin coherence time. By spatially patterning the diamond surface with regions functionalised by DNA tethers of different lengths, sequences, or chemical modifications, a single liquid is mapped onto a high-dimensional quantum response vector rather than a single scalar observable. Changes in viscosity, molecular adsorption, or chemical interactions modify the dynamics of magnetic nanoparticles in a region-specific manner, enabling differential sensing across the surface. We outline the physical transduction mechanism, discuss relevant scaling relations, and assess experimental feasibility using established wide-field NV magnetometry and relaxometry methods. The proposed platform combines quantum sensing with surface heterogeneity, offering a versatile route toward parallel, label-free liquid characterisation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（提出新概念与物理机制，结合已有实验方法评估可行性）。判断依据关键词：propose a new concept、outline the physical transduction mechanism、assess experimental feasibility。；研究对象：基于氮-空位（NV）中心磁力测量与弛豫测量、结合表面锚定磁性纳米颗粒的液体多参数量子传感体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将磁性纳米颗粒用DNA链锚定在金刚石表面形成纳米机械振子，其热运动受液体环境影响，进而产生时变磁场耦合到近表面NV中心，可将单一液体的性质映射为高维量子响应向量，实现非侵入式、多参数液体分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将磁性纳米颗粒用DNA链锚定在金刚石表面形成纳米机械振子，其热运动受液体环境影响，进而产生时变磁场耦合到近表面NV中心，可将单一液体的性质映射为高维量子响应向量，实现非侵入式、多参数液体分析。；创新点：将量子传感与表面异质性结合，通过空间图案化DNA锚定区域实现差分传感，使单一液体产生高维响应向量（而非单一标量可观测量），从而并行、无标记地表征液体的粘度、分子吸附或化学相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论提出物理转换机制，讨论标度关系，并基于已建立的宽场NV磁力测量与弛豫测量方法评估实验可行性。具体涉及：光探测磁共振（ODMR）、自旋相干时间测量、DNA不同长度/序列/化学修饰的空间图案化表面功能化。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Symbolic Regression through Bayesian Support Selection
papers.abstract: The Sure Independence Screening and Sparsifying Operator (SISSO) framework is a powerful symbolic-regression method for extracting compact and interpretable descriptors from large nonlinear feature spaces. However, standard SISSO is deterministic: it returns a single descriptor and point prediction, without quantifying uncertainty in descriptor selection, regression coefficients, or predictions. Here we introduce a probabilistic extension in which the sure independence screening (SIS) stage is kept deterministic to preserve scalability, while the sparsifying operator (SO) stage is reformulated as Bayesian inference over the SIS-screened support space. The resulting deterministic-SIS/Bayesian-SO framework yields posterior probabilities for competing descriptor supports, feature-inclusion probabilities, Bayesian-model-averaged predictions, and predictive credible intervals, while recovering the deterministic SO descriptor of standard SISSO in the maximum-a-posteriori limit. Applied to an $X_2YZ$ Heusler-alloy magnetic-moment dataset, the approach gives modest improvements in five-fold cross-validation RMSE and near-nominal empirical coverage of the 95$\%$ predictive intervals. More importantly, the posterior exposes competing, physically related symbolic descriptor families that would appear artificially unique in a deterministic analysis. These results suggest that deterministic-SIS/Bayesian-SO can be used as an uncertainty-aware diagnostic extension of SISSO: a tool for assessing descriptor confidence, stability, and non-uniqueness in small-data materials regression problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：symbolic-regression method、Bayesian inference、posterior probabilities、deterministic-SIS/Bayesian-SO framework。；研究对象：材料科学中的小数据回归问题，具体以 $X_2YZ$ Heusler合金的磁矩数据集为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将SISSO框架中的稀疏化算子阶段重构为贝叶斯推断，该方法能够量化描述符选择、回归系数和预测的不确定性，并揭示在确定性分析中看似唯一、实则相互竞争的物理相关描述符族。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将SISSO框架中的稀疏化算子阶段重构为贝叶斯推断，该方法能够量化描述符选择、回归系数和预测的不确定性，并揭示在确定性分析中看似唯一、实则相互竞争的物理相关描述符族。；创新点：将不确定性量化引入符号回归方法SISSO，使其从确定性单描述符输出扩展为能够评估描述符置信度、稳定性和非唯一性的诊断工具。
papers.method_zh: 采用确定性SIS（Sure Independence Screening）与贝叶斯SO（Sparsifying Operator）相结合的混合框架。SIS阶段保持确定性以保证可扩展性，SO阶段则通过贝叶斯推断在SIS筛选后的支持空间上进行后验概率计算，最终得到描述符后验概率、特征包含概率、贝叶斯模型平均预测及预测可信区间。

papers.title: Deformable Charge Dynamics in Biological Environments: An Extended Structural Dynamics Foundation for Biological Electrostatics
papers.abstract: The point-charge approximation is one of the most successful idealizations in molecular biophysics, but it becomes strained in strong fields, confined geometries, and crowded aqueous environments. We develop a minimal Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) model in which charged entities are treated as finite, deformable objects with an internal breathing mode rather than as structureless points. Starting from a Hamiltonian description and a controlled coarse-graining procedure, we derive an effective generalized Langevin equation for the center-of-mass motion. The reduced dynamics contain a memory kernel with three physically distinct contributions: finite-size causal delay, inertial deformation, and crowding-induced deformation. The derivation rests on explicit assumptions of small deformation, local dielectric screening, one dominant internal mode, and adiabatic elimination of the fast structural coordinate. Parameters are determined by independently measurable inputs -- ionic radius, charge, mass, and the high-frequency dielectric constant of water -- with one exception: the dimensionless coupling lambda governing crowding-induced deformation, discussed in detail in the paper. Two primary predictions follow. First, transport through confined geometries should show dynamical deviations from point-charge baselines scaling with ionic deformability, beyond static potential-of-mean-force predictions. Second, polarization response should preserve ionic-radius ordering across alkali ions. Two secondary consequences are identified: a field-dependent effective charge radius and a deformation-dependent correction to near-surface mobility. Amplification of these effects in confined settings is treated as a plausible extension rather than a derived result. The framework recovers standard electrostatic models as limiting cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a minimal Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) model”、“derive an effective generalized Langevin equation”、“The derivation rests on explicit assumptions”等，属于理论模型的构建与推导。；研究对象：生物环境中的带电实体（如离子）的静电动力学行为。具体关注在强场、受限几何结构（如纳米孔道）和拥挤水溶液环境中，传统点电荷近似失效时的电荷输运与极化响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作发现，将带电实体视为具有内部呼吸模式的有限大小可变形物体，会导致其质心运动出现三种物理起源不同的记忆效应：有限尺寸因果延迟、惯性形变和拥挤诱导形变。这些效应会导致在受限几何中的输运偏离点电荷基准，且极化响应会保留碱金属离子的半径顺序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作发现，将带电实体视为具有内部呼吸模式的有限大小可变形物体，会导致其质心运动出现三种物理起源不同的记忆效应：有限尺寸因果延迟、惯性形变和拥挤诱导形变。这些效应会导致在受限几何中的输运偏离点电荷基准，且极化响应会保留碱金属离子的半径顺序。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于提出了一个超越传统点电荷近似的“最小”理论框架，将带电实体的有限尺寸和可变形性（内禀呼吸模式）纳入生物静电学的动力学描述中，并系统揭示了由此产生的三种不同物理起源的记忆效应及其对输运和极化的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用扩展结构动力学（ESD）模型。从哈密顿量描述出发，通过受控的粗粒化过程，推导出质心运动的有效广义朗之万方程。推导基于小形变、局域介电屏蔽、单一主导内模以及绝热消除快结构坐标等假设。模型参数由独立可测量的输入量（离子半径、电荷、质量、水的高频介电常数）确定，仅有一个无量纲耦合常数λ需在论文中详细讨论。

papers.title: Forman--Ricci Curvature for Irregular Convex Mosaics
papers.abstract: Forman has defined a discrete version of the Ricci curvature on Riemannian manifolds, known as the Forman--Ricci curvature. The Forman--Ricci curvature has found significant applications in several pattern recognition problems occurring in natural sciences. Domokos and Langi, on the other hand, have defined a notion of irregularity for convex mosaics, which has also found remarkable applications to the geological problem of fractures in rocks. We define a modification of the classical Forman--Ricci curvature for irregular convex mosaics and demonstrate how they can be used to distinguish between various fractures or cracking patterns appearing in nature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中定义了“Forman--Ricci曲率”的修正版本，并讨论其应用，属于数学物理理论框架的构建。；研究对象：不规则凸镶嵌（irregular convex mosaics）及其在自然界中产生的断裂或裂纹图案（fractures or cracking patterns）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义一种针对不规则凸镶嵌的修正Forman--Ricci曲率，可以区分自然界中不同类型的断裂或裂纹图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义一种针对不规则凸镶嵌的修正Forman--Ricci曲率，可以区分自然界中不同类型的断裂或裂纹图案。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于离散微分几何中的Forman--Ricci曲率定义，结合Domokos和Langi提出的不规则凸镶嵌概念，提出一种修正的曲率计算方法，并应用于裂纹图案的区分。

papers.title: Round-Robin Test of a Light-Emitting Electrochemical Cell: Establishing a Reference Protocol for Quality Research
papers.abstract: Emerging technologies benefit from a jointly established reference protocol, which can lower the bar of entry for new researchers while serving as a calibration standard for established actors. The light-emitting electrochemical cell (LEC) combines electrochemistry and optoelectronics in an intricate manner, and it can by that enable sustainable and commercially relevant printing fabrication of emissive thin-film devices. However, LEC performance is sensitive to a range of material and processing parameters, which frequently results in inadequate, or even erroneous, device evaluation. With this in mind, we present herein a LEC reference protocol, which details the sourcing of materials and the procedures and parameters for robust device fabrication and operation. The protocol has been tested across nine international research groups, and the collected results from this interlaboratory round-robin test confirm that good LEC performance can be reproducibly obtained following our protocol. We also identify common pitfalls that can arise during LEC development, and present practical steps for attaining optimum LEC performance. We hope this reference protocol will improve the quality of future LEC research and serve as a guide for future researchers entering this vibrant field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“interlaboratory round-robin test”（跨实验室循环测试），并详细描述了材料来源、器件制备和操作流程的测试。；研究对象：发光电化学池（LEC，Light-Emitting Electrochemical Cell），一种结合电化学与光电子学的薄膜发光器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过制定并跨九个国际实验室验证的参考协议，可以可重复地获得良好的LEC器件性能，并识别出常见陷阱及优化步骤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过制定并跨九个国际实验室验证的参考协议，可以可重复地获得良好的LEC器件性能，并识别出常见陷阱及优化步骤。；创新点：首次为LEC领域建立并实验验证了一套标准化的参考协议，旨在降低新研究者入门门槛，并为已有研究者提供校准基准，提升研究质量。
papers.method_zh: 跨实验室循环测试（round-robin test），具体包括：统一规定材料来源、器件制备流程和操作参数，并在九个研究组中重复执行以验证可重复性。

papers.title: Entropy-Compatible Reconstruction for High-Weissenberg Viscoelastic Flow
papers.abstract: Log-conformation and square-root reconstructions preserve positive definiteness in high-Weissenberg viscoelastic simulations, but positivity alone does not guarantee compatibility with the discrete free-energy balance. We identify three reconstruction-level mechanisms by which strictly positive tensors can still generate nonphysical behavior: Jensen-type entropy bias, exponential amplification of logarithmic perturbations in highly stretched states, and sign-indefinite polymeric-work defects caused by using incompatible tensors in stress work and entropy variables. We formulate an entropy-compatible reconstruction principle and a corrected logarithmic reconstruction selected by a least-damping entropy constraint. The correction is local, positive, computable by bisection, spectrally controlled, and compatible with coupled velocity--pressure--conformation time stepping. We prove existence of the maximal admissible parameter, convexity of the entropy profile along the logarithmic path, a compatible free-energy estimate, a defect-budget estimate for noncompatible reconstructions, asymptotic inactivity on high-order admissible defects, and a conditional high-stretch resolution advantage in log-relative and entropy metrics. Reproducible diagnostics compare logarithmic, square-root, and linear reconstructions and verify the predicted entropy defects, work defects, stress-force errors, and high-Weissenberg accumulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了“熵兼容重构原理”、“修正的对数重构”等理论框架，并使用了“证明存在性”、“凸性分析”等数学论证，同时提及了“可重复的诊断比较”和“数值模拟”中的验证。；研究对象：高魏森伯格数（High-Weissenberg）粘弹性流体流动的数值模拟。具体关注的是在模拟中用于保证聚合物构象张量正定性的重构方法（如对数构象和平方根重构）的物理一致性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 严格正定的张量重构方法（如对数构象法）并不自动保证与离散自由能平衡的兼容性，可能因熵偏差、指数放大和功缺陷等机制产生非物理行为。作者提出了一种熵兼容的重构原理和一种通过最小阻尼熵约束选定的修正对数重构方法，解决了上述问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：严格正定的张量重构方法（如对数构象法）并不自动保证与离散自由能平衡的兼容性，可能因熵偏差、指数放大和功缺陷等机制产生非物理行为。作者提出了一种熵兼容的重构原理和一种通过最小阻尼熵约束选定的修正对数重构方法，解决了上述问题。；创新点：首次明确指出并系统分析了在粘弹性流体高魏森伯格数模拟中，即使保持张量正定性，重构方法仍可能违反离散自由能平衡的物理机制。提出了一个全新的“熵兼容重构”原则，并基于此设计了一种局部、正定、可通过二分法计算、谱可控且与耦合时间步进兼容的修正对数重构方案，并给出了严格的数学证明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值诊断相结合。理论方面：识别了三种导致非物理行为的重构层面机制（Jensen型熵偏差、高拉伸态下对数扰动的指数放大、应力功与熵变量中张量不兼容导致的符号不定聚合物功缺陷），并基于此提出了熵兼容重构原理和修正对数重构方法，通过数学证明（存在性、凸性、能量估计等）支撑其有效性。数值方面：通过可重复的诊断比较，对比了对数、平方根和线性重构方法，验证了预测的熵缺陷、功缺陷、应力-力误差和高魏森伯格数累积效应。

papers.title: Mobility Heterogeneity in a 2D Gaussian Lattice Polymer: A Dynamic Monte Carlo Study
papers.abstract: We study mobility heterogeneity in a two-dimensional Gaussian lattice polymer using dynamic Monte Carlo simulations. The polymer dynamics is generated from a local three-monomer move dictionary, which explicitly enumerates allowed bond-preserving updates on a square lattice. As a homogeneous benchmark, this dictionary reproduces the expected Rouse-like behavior of an ideal chain, including the crossover in monomer mean-squared displacement (MSD) and the center-of-mass diffusion scaling $D_{\rm cm} \sim N^{-1}$.
